//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#ifndef GENERICML_GRAPHCOMPILER_MODIALECT_MOTYPES_TD
#define GENERICML_GRAPHCOMPILER_MODIALECT_MOTYPES_TD

include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MODialect.td"
include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOTypeInterfaces.td"
include "Support/Compiler/TensorUtils.td"
include "mlir/IR/BuiltinTypeInterfaces.td"
include "mlir/IR/EnumAttr.td"

class MO_Type<string name, string typeMnemonic, list<Trait> traits = []>
    : TypeDef<MODialect, name, traits> {
  let mnemonic = typeMnemonic;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MO_Tensor
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MO_Tensor : MO_Type<"Tensor", "tensor", [MO_HasDeviceTypeInterface, MO_ShapedTypeInterface,
  DeclareTypeInterfaceMethods<MO_KernelOperandTypeInterface>]> {
  let summary = "Type of tensor specs of statically known rank.";
  let description = [{
    A tensor's shape and element type, an optional device ref, and an optional
    metadata dictionary (e.g. layout).

    `shape` is a `MOSH::ShapeAttr` (e.g. `[D0, 42, N]`) with static rank;
    dimensions may be integers or parametric. The element type is an M::DType,
    with `invalid` meaning unknown.

    Examples:
    ```mlir
    !mo.tensor<[4, 16], f32>           // static shape
    !mo.tensor<[N, N, 6], i32>         // parameterized shape
    !mo.tensor<[1, M, N], i32>         // partially known and parameterized shape
    !mo.tensor<[4, 16], f32, gpu:0>    // optional device
    ```
  }];

  let parameters = (ins
    "::M::MOSH::ShapeAttr" : $shape,
    "DType" : $dtype,
    DefaultValuedParameter<"::M::DeviceRefAttr", "::M::DeviceRefAttr::getDefault($_ctxt)"> : $deviceRef,
    DefaultValuedParameter<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata);

  let genVerifyDecl = 1;
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
  let skipDefaultBuilders = 1;

  let builders = [
    // Base builder which all others call.
    TypeBuilder<(ins
      "MOSH::ShapeAttr" : $shape,
      "DType" : $dtype,
      "DeviceRefAttr" : $deviceRef,
      "DictionaryAttr" : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins
      "MOSH::ShapeAttr" : $shape,
      "DType" : $dtype,
      CArg<"DeviceRefAttr", "{}"> : $deviceRef,
      CArg<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins
      "MOSH::ShapeAttr" : $shape,
      "Type" : $elementType,
      CArg<"DeviceRefAttr", "{}"> : $deviceRef,
      CArg<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins
      "ArrayRef<int64_t>" : $shape,
      "Type" : $elementType,
      CArg<"DeviceRefAttr", "{}"> : $deviceRef,
      CArg<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins
      "ArrayRef<TypedAttr>" : $shape,
      "Type" : $elementType,
      CArg<"DeviceRefAttr", "{}"> : $deviceRef,
      CArg<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilder<(ins
      "ArrayRef<int64_t>" : $shape,
      "DType" : $dtype,
      CArg<"DeviceRefAttr", "{}"> : $deviceRef,
      CArg<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilder<(ins
      "ArrayRef<TypedAttr>" : $shape,
      "DType" : $dtype,
      CArg<"DeviceRefAttr", "{}"> : $deviceRef,
      CArg<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata)>];

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    TensorType cloneWith(
      ArrayRef<int64_t> shape, Type dtype) const;
    TensorType cloneWith(
      ArrayRef<TypedAttr> shapeDims) const;
    TensorType cloneWith(MOSH::ShapeAttr shape) const;
    TensorType cloneWith(DType dtype) const;
    TensorType cloneWith(LayoutAttr layoutAttr) const;
    TensorType cloneWithoutLayout() const;
    TensorType cloneWith(IOKindAttr ioKindAttr) const;
    TensorType cloneWithoutIOKind() const;
    TensorType cloneWith(DictionaryAttr metadataAttr) const;
    TensorType cloneWith(DeviceRefAttr device) const;

    bool hasRank() const;

    /// Fails if not statically ranked.
    size_t getRank() const;

    /// Like getRank, but scalars are rank 1.
    size_t getRankNonZero() const;

    bool hasStaticShape() const;

    Type getElementType() const;

    /// Returns the referenced parameter names (shape or dimension).
    SmallPtrSet<StringAttr, 4> getUsedParamNames() const;

    /// Fails if the shape is unknown.
    ArrayRef<TypedAttr> getDims() const;

    /// Fails if the shape is unknown.
    TypedAttr getDim(size_t n) const;

    /// True for parameters and parametric expressions (e.g. A + 2), not `?`.
    /// Fails if dynamically ranked.
    bool isParameterizedDim(size_t n) const;

    /// Fails if dynamically ranked.
    bool isIntegerDim(size_t n) const;

    static bool isParameterizedDimParam(TypedAttr attr);
    static bool isIntegerDimParam(TypedAttr attr);

    /// Unknown dimensions are mlir::ShapedType::kDynamic. Fails if the shape is
    /// unknown.
    SmallVector<int64_t> getIntDims() const;

    /// Unknown dimensions are mlir::ShapedType::kDynamic. Fails if the shape is
    /// unknown.
    int64_t getIntDim(size_t n) const;

    /// Fails if not statically ranked.
    TypedAttr getSymbolicNumElements() const;

    /// Returns no value unless all dimensions are known integers >= 0.
    std::optional<int64_t> getNumElements() const;

    static TensorType getScalarType(Type elementType,
      DeviceRefAttr deviceRef = {}, DictionaryAttr metadata = {});

    static TensorType getVectorSI64Type(MLIRContext *ctx, int64_t size,
      DeviceRefAttr deviceRef = {}, DictionaryAttr metadata = {});

    /// Returns a null `LayoutAttr{}` if there is none.
    MO::LayoutAttr getLayoutAttr();

    /// Returns a null `IOKindAttr{}` if there is none.
    MO::IOKindAttr getIOKindAttr();

    BoolAttr getIsMutableAttr();

    TensorType cloneWithMut(BoolAttr isMutable) const;

    TensorType cloneWithNewDim(uint64_t dim, uint64_t size);

    /// Returns a clone marked stable.
    TensorType cloneWithStable(bool isStable = true) const;

    /// Returns true if the tensor is stable: its data pointer is a stable
    /// address slot rather than the data itself, so a kernel must read
    /// through it at run time (see `!mgp.stable_addr`).
    bool isStable() const;
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MO_List
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MO_List : MO_Type<"List", "list", [MO_HasDeviceTypeInterface,
  DeclareTypeInterfaceMethods<MO_HasDeviceTypeInterface, ["getDeviceRef", "cloneWithNewDevice"]>]>
{
  let summary = "Type of immutable list container.";
  let description = [{
    Elements are currently restricted to `!mo.tensor`.
  }];

  let parameters = (ins "Type":$elementType);
  let assemblyFormat = "`<` $elementType `>`";
  let genVerifyDecl = 1;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MO_Bundle
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MO_Bundle : MO_Type<"Bundle", "bundle"> {
  let summary = "Ordered collection of per-device tensors.";
  let description = [{
    Bundles per-device `!mo.tensor`s into one SSA value. Elements may differ in
    device, shape, or dtype.

    The verbose syntax lists each element and is used for non-uniform
    elements:

    ```mlir
    !mo.bundle<[!mo.tensor<[3], f32, gpu:0>, !mo.tensor<[4], f32, gpu:1>]>
    ```

    The compact syntax is used when all elements share shape, dtype, device
    label, and metadata, with contiguous device IDs (`ids[i] == ids[0] + i`):

    ```mlir
    !mo.bundle<[3], f32, gpu:0-1>
    ```

    A single element omits the range, and on the default host device omits
    the device too:

    ```mlir
    !mo.bundle<[3], f32, gpu:0>   // single element, explicit device
    !mo.bundle<[3], f32>          // single element, default host device
    ```

    Both forms store the same `elementTypes`.
  }];

  let parameters = (ins ArrayRefParameter<"Type">:$elementTypes);
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
  let genVerifyDecl = 1;

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    size_t getNumElements() const { return getElementTypes().size(); }
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MO_Scalar
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MO_Scalar : MO_Type<"Scalar", "scalar",
  [DeclareTypeInterfaceMethods<MO_KernelOperandTypeInterface>]> {
  let summary = "Type of scalars.";
  let parameters = (ins
    "DType" : $dtype);

  let assemblyFormat = "`<` $dtype `>`";

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    Type getDType() const;
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MO_Buffer
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MO_Buffer : MO_Type<"Buffer", "buffer", [MO_HasDeviceTypeInterface, MO_ShapedTypeInterface,
  DeclareTypeInterfaceMethods<MO_ShapedTypeInterface>,
  DeclareTypeInterfaceMethods<MO_KernelOperandTypeInterface>]> {
  let summary = "Mutable tensor type.";
  let description = [{
    A mutable analogue of `!mo.tensor`; with mo.mutable.load and
    mo.mutable.store it models in-place operations. `shape` is a statically
    ranked `MOSH::ShapeAttr`; dtype `invalid` means unknown.

    Examples:
    ```mlir
    !mo.buffer<[4, 16], f32>    // static shape
    !mo.buffer<[N, N, 6], i32>  // parameterized shape
    ```
  }];

  let parameters = (ins
    "::M::MOSH::ShapeAttr" : $shape,
    "DType" : $dtype,
    DefaultValuedParameter<"::M::DeviceRefAttr", "::M::DeviceRefAttr::getDefault($_ctxt)"> : $deviceRef,
    DefaultValuedParameter<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata);

  let genVerifyDecl = 1;
  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
  let skipDefaultBuilders = 1;

  let builders = [
    // Base builder which all others call
    TypeBuilder<(ins
      "MOSH::ShapeAttr" : $shape,
      "DType" : $dtype,
      "DeviceRefAttr" : $deviceRef,
      "DictionaryAttr" : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins
      "MOSH::ShapeAttr" : $shape,
      "DType" : $dtype,
      CArg<"DeviceRefAttr", "{}"> : $deviceRef,
      CArg<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins
      "MOSH::ShapeAttr" : $shape,
      "Type" : $elementType,
      CArg<"DeviceRefAttr", "{}"> : $deviceRef,
      CArg<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins
      "ArrayRef<TypedAttr>" : $shape,
      "Type" : $elementType,
      CArg<"DeviceRefAttr", "{}"> : $deviceRef,
      CArg<"DictionaryAttr", "{}"> : $metadata)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins
      "TensorType" : $tensorType)>,
  ];

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    /// The type must not already have a device annotation.
    BufferType cloneWith(DeviceRefAttr deviceRef) const;

    static TensorType toTensorType(BufferType type);
    TensorType toTensorType();
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MO_Chain
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MO_Chain : MO_Type<"Chain", "chain"> {
  let summary = "Controls sequencing of side-effecting operations.";
  let description = [{
    Every side-effecting MO op consumes and produces a chain.
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MO_Opaque
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MO_Opaque : MO_Type<"Opaque", "opaque",
  [DeclareTypeInterfaceMethods<MO_KernelOperandTypeInterface,
                               ["getKernelOperandOpaqueName"]>]> {
  let summary = "Opaque MO type.";
  let description = [{
    A custom user-defined type.
      Example:
      ```mlir
        !mo.opaque<"my_list">
        !mo.opaque<"my_list", {foo = 42}>
      ```
  }];

  let parameters = (ins
    "StringAttr": $symbol,
    DefaultValuedParameter<"::mlir::DictionaryAttr",
                           "::mlir::DictionaryAttr::get($_ctxt)">:$parameters
  );

  let builders = [
    TypeBuilder<(ins "StringAttr": $symbol, "DictionaryAttr": $parameters)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins "StringAttr": $symbol)>,
    TypeBuilderWithInferredContext<(ins "StringAttr": $symbol,
                                        "DictionaryAttr": $parameters)>,
  ];

  let assemblyFormat = "`<` $symbol (`,` $parameters^)? `>`";
  let skipDefaultBuilders = true;

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    /// For converting to MGP::OpaqueType; std::nullopt if empty.
    std::optional<DictionaryAttr> getOptionalParameters() const {
      DictionaryAttr params = getParameters();
      if (params && !params.empty())
        return params;
      return std::nullopt;
    }
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// ODS constraints to inject verifier logic via type annotation.
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

class MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<list<int> ranks> :
  Or<!foreach(rank, ranks,
    CPred<[{cast<MO::TensorType>($_self).getRank() == }] # rank>)>;

class MO_BufferHasAnyRankOfPred<list<int> ranks> :
  Or<!foreach(rank, ranks,
    CPred<[{cast<MO::BufferType>($_self).toTensorType().getRank() == }] # rank>)>;

def FloatElementTypePred : CPred<
  "llvm::isa<FloatType>(cast<::M::MO::TensorType>($_self).getElementType())">;

def IntOrIndexElementTypePred : CPred<
  "cast<::M::MO::TensorType>($_self).getElementType().isInteger()">;

def SignedElementTypePred : CPred<
  "!cast<::M::MO::TensorType>($_self).getElementType().isUnsignedInteger() && "
  "!cast<::M::MO::TensorType>($_self).getDtype().isBool()">;

def HasSI64ElementTypePred : SubstLeaves<
  "$_self", "cast<M::MO::TensorType>($_self).getElementType()", SI64.predicate>;

def HasSI32ElementTypePred : SubstLeaves<
  "$_self", "cast<M::MO::TensorType>($_self).getElementType()", SI32.predicate>;

def HasBoolElementTypePred : SubstLeaves<
  "$_self", "cast<M::MO::TensorType>($_self).getElementType()", I1.predicate>;

class MO_ConfinedBuffer<list<Pred> predicates, string summary = ""> :
  ConfinedType<MO_Buffer, predicates, summary, "::M::MO::BufferType">;

def MO_Rank1Buffer: MO_ConfinedBuffer<
  [MO_BufferHasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>], "rank-1 buffer">;

class MO_ConfinedTensor<list<Pred> predicates, string summary = ""> :
  ConfinedType<MO_Tensor, predicates, summary, "::M::MO::TensorType">;

class MO_ConfinedScalar<list<Pred> predicates, string summary = ""> :
  ConfinedType<MO_Scalar, predicates, summary, "::M::MO::ScalarType">;

def BoolScalarPred : CPred<
  "cast<::M::MO::ScalarType>($_self).getDtype().isBool()">;

def MO_BoolScalar : MO_ConfinedScalar<[BoolScalarPred], "boolean scalar">;

/// Excludes !mo.buffer because there is no alias analysis for ops that
/// forward their inputs (e.g. mo.guard, control flow with mo.yield).
/// TODO(GEX-1576): Implement alias analysis
def MO_AnyNonBufferType : Type<
  CPred<"!llvm::isa<::M::MO::BufferType>($_self)">,
  "any type but !mo.buffer">;

def MO_RankedScalarTensor : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[0]>], "ranked scalar tensor">;

def MO_ScalarTensorIfRanked : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[0]>], "scalar or unranked tensor">;

def MO_RankedScalarIndexTensor : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[0]>, IntOrIndexElementTypePred],
  "ranked scalar index tensor">;

def MO_RankedScalarFloatTensor : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[0]>, FloatElementTypePred],
  "ranked scalar floating point tensor">;

def MO_FloatScalarIfRanked : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [FloatElementTypePred, MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[0]>],
  "rank 0 or unranked with float elements">;

def MO_FloatTensor : MO_ConfinedTensor<[FloatElementTypePred], "floating point tensor">;

def MO_NonScalarIfRanked: MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [Neg<MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[0]>>], "unranked or non-scalar tensor">;

def MO_Rank1FloatTensor: MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>, FloatElementTypePred], "rank-1 tensor with floats">;

def MO_Rank1IndexTensor: MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>, IntOrIndexElementTypePred], "rank-1 tensor with indices">;

def MO_Rank2IndexTensor: MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[2]>, IntOrIndexElementTypePred], "rank-2 index tensor">;

def MO_Rank2SI32Tensor : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[2]>, HasSI32ElementTypePred],
  "rank-2 tensor with signed 32-bit integer elements">;

def MO_Rank1Tensor: MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>], "rank-1 tensor">;

def MO_Rank2Tensor: MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[2]>], "rank-2 tensor">;

def MO_Rank3Tensor: MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[3]>], "rank-3 tensor">;

def MO_Rank4Tensor: MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[4]>], "rank-4 tensor">;

def MO_IndicesTensor : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [IntOrIndexElementTypePred], "tensor with integer or index elements">;

def MO_SignedTensor : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [SignedElementTypePred], "tensor with signed elements">;

def MO_ShapeLike : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>, Or<[HasSI64ElementTypePred,
                                 HasSI32ElementTypePred]>],
  "rank 1 and signed 64 or signed 32 integer elements">;

def MO_PaddingLike : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>, Or<[HasSI64ElementTypePred, HasSI32ElementTypePred]>],
  "shape [N] and signed 64 or signed 32 integer elements">;

def MO_PaddingLikeIfRanked : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>, Or<[HasSI64ElementTypePred, HasSI32ElementTypePred]>],
  "unranked or shape [N] and signed 64 or signed 32 integer elements">;

def MO_ShapeLikeIfRanked : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>, Or<[HasSI64ElementTypePred,
                               HasSI32ElementTypePred]>],
  "rank 1 or unranked with signed 64 or signed 32 integer elements">;

def MO_VectorIfRanked : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>], "rank 1 or unranked">;

def MO_IndicesVectorIfRanked : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [IntOrIndexElementTypePred, MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[1]>],
  "rank 1 or unranked with integer or index elements">;

def MO_IndexScalarIfRanked : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [IntOrIndexElementTypePred, MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[0]>],
  "rank 0 or unranked with integer or index elements">;

def MO_MatrixIfRanked : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[2]>], "rank 2 or unranked">;

def MO_ScalarOfAnyRank : MO_ConfinedTensor<
  [CPred<"cast<MO::TensorType>($_self).getNumElements().value_or(0) == 1">],
  "Has exactly one element">;

def MO_BooleanMask : MO_ConfinedTensor<
    [HasBoolElementTypePred], "boolean element type">;

def MO_CondLike :
  ConfinedType<MO_Tensor,
    [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[0]>, HasBoolElementTypePred],
    "rank 0 and boolean element type"> {
  let cppType = "::M::MO::TensorType";

  let builderCall = [{
    ::MO::TensorType::get(::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::TypedAttr>{},
                          $_builder.getI1Type())
  }];
}

def MO_CondLikeIfRanked : ConfinedType<MO_Tensor,
    [MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[0]>, HasBoolElementTypePred],
    "rank 0 or unranked with boolean element type"> {
  let cppType = "::M::MO::TensorType";
}

def MO_I64Tensor : ConfinedType<MO_Tensor,
    [HasSI64ElementTypePred],
    "signed 64 integer element type"> {
  let cppType = "::M::MO::TensorType";
}

def MO_Rank2I64Tensor : ConfinedType<MO_Tensor,
    [HasSI64ElementTypePred, MO_HasAnyRankOfPred<[2]>],
    "rank 2 signed 64 integer tensor"> {
  let cppType = "::M::MO::TensorType";
}

class DTypeStrFunc<string name> : StrFunc<"::M::MO::getDTypeOrInvalid($" # name # ".getType())">;

class ShapeAttrStrFunc<string name> : StrFunc<"::M::MO::getShape($" # name # ".getType())">;

/// e.g. `AllDTypesMatch<["input", "result"]>`. The builtin
/// `AllElementTypesMatch` doesn't work with MO::TensorType.
class AllDTypesMatch<list<string> names> :
    AllMatchSameOperatorTrait<names, DTypeStrFunc<"_self">.result,
                              "dtype">;

class AllShapeAttrsMatch<list<string> names> :
    AllMatchSameOperatorTrait<names, ShapeAttrStrFunc<"_self">.result,
                              "shape">;

#endif // GENERICML_GRAPHCOMPILER_MODIALECT_MOTYPES_TD

class MOGG_Op<string mnemonic, list<Trait> traits = []> :
  Op<MOGGDialect, mnemonic, traits>;

// Ops that call a kernel, a primitive or a `mogg.func`.
def MOGG_CallLike : NativeOpTrait<"CallLike"> {
  let cppNamespace = "::M::MOGG";
}

class MOGG_LowerableOp<string mnemonic, list<Trait> traits = []> :
  MOGG_Op<mnemonic, traits # [
    DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<LowerableToMGPInterface, ["lower"]>,
  ]>;

class MOGG_KernelTerminatorOp<string mnemonic, list<Trait> traits = []> :
  MOGG_Op<mnemonic, traits # [
    DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_KernelTerminator>,
    Terminator,
  ]>;

def DimensionType : ScalarOfDType<BoundAnd<DTypeConstraint<"*$_self == KGEN::KGENDType::si64">>, "!kgen.simd<1, si64>">,
    BuildableType<"KGEN::SIMDType::get(1, KGEN::DTypeConstantAttr::get("
                                   "$_builder.getContext(), KGEN::KGENDType::si64))">;

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Internal helper ops
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MOGG_ConcatOp : MOGG_LowerableOp<"concat", [
  MO_HasDeviceInterface,
  MO_SingleDevice,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Concat Operation along axis zero";
  let description = [{
    Example:

    ```mlir
    %arg0: !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>
    %arg1: !mo.tensor<[2, 3], f32>
    %res = mogg.concat(%arg0, %arg1) : (
      !mo.tensor<[3, 3], f32>, !mo.tensor<[2, 3], f32>
    ) -> !mo.tensor<[5, 3], f32>
    ```

    Works for CUDA and host devices.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins Variadic<MO_Tensor>:$inputs);
  let results = (outs MO_Tensor:$result);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $inputs `)` attr-dict `:` functional-type($inputs, results)
  }];
}

def MOGG_SplitOp : MOGG_LowerableOp<"split", [Pure]> {
  let summary = "Split Operation along axis zero";
  let description = [{
    `mo.split` with `axis` zero; the split sizes are implied by the result
    types.

    Example:

    ```mlir
    %input: !mo.tensor<[9, 8], f32>
    %res = mogg.split(%input) : (!mo.tensor<[9, 8], f32> ) ->
    (!mo.tensor<[2, 8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[3, 8], f32>, !mo.tensor<[4, 8], f32>)
    ```

    Currently only for the 'host' device.
    TODO: Generalize to arbitrary devices.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins MO_Tensor:$input);
  let results = (outs Variadic<MO_Tensor>:$results);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $input `)` attr-dict `:` `(`
      qualified(type($input)) `)` `->` `(` type($results) `)`
  }];
}

def MOGG_SliceOp : MOGG_Op<"slice", [
  MO_HasDeviceInterface,
  MO_SingleDeviceWithHostOperands<["start", "stop"]>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Contiguous zero-copy slice op lowerable to mgp.tensor.slice";
  let description = [{
    Unlike mo.slice, not lowered to a kernel by MOToMOGG. FuseViews lowers it
    to a mogg.routine temporarily and raises it back if unfused.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    MO_Tensor:$input,
    MO_IndexScalarIfRanked:$start,
    MO_IndexScalarIfRanked:$stop
  );
  let results = (outs MO_Tensor:$result);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` operands `)` attr-dict `:` functional-type(operands, results)
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// OutputOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MOGG_OutputOp : MOGG_Op<"output", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  ReturnLike,
  Terminator,
]> {
  let summary = "MOGG output operation";
  let description = [{
    Specifies the output values of a region in a MOGG operation.

    ```mlir
      mogg.op foo() {
      ... mogg.output e0, % 1 : i32, f8
    } : i32, f8
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins Variadic<AnyType>:$operands);
  let assemblyFormat = "attr-dict ($operands^ `:` type($operands))?";
}


//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MOGG abstract compiled components representation
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MOGG_CallOp : MOGG_Op<"call", [
  MOGG_CallLike,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<SymbolUserOpInterface>,
  MOGG_FuncCallOpInterface,
]> {
  let summary = "Calls into an outlined stub";
  let description = [{}];
  let arguments = (ins
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$name,
    Variadic<AnyType>:$inputs,
    OptionalAttr<I64Attr>:$affinity_device_id
  );
  let results = (outs Variadic<AnyType>:$outputs);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $name ($inputs^ `:` type($inputs))? (`->` type($outputs)^)?
    (`affinity_device_id` `=` $affinity_device_id^)? attr-dict
  }];

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    FuncOp getCallee();
  }];
}

def MOGG_CallAsyncOp : MOGG_Op<"call.async", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<SymbolUserOpInterface>,
  MOGG_FuncCallOpInterface,
]> {
  let summary = "Calls into an outlined stub asynchronously";
  let description = [{
    Dispatches via Mojo `create_task`. `affinity_device_id` pins the task to a
    CPU core with NUMA affinity for that GPU. It is a plain integer because
    kernel-layer device refs are label-only.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$name,
    Variadic<AnyType>:$inputs,
    OptionalAttr<I64Attr>:$affinity_device_id
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_TaskHandle:$task_handle);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $name (`(` $inputs^ `:` type($inputs) `)`)?
    (`affinity_device_id` `=` $affinity_device_id^)? attr-dict
  }];

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    FuncOp getCallee();
  }];
}

def MOGG_CallBuildGraphOp : MOGG_Op<"call.build_graph", [
  AttrSizedOperandSegments,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MOGG_KernelCallInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<SymbolUserOpInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Record a kernel's `build_graph` function into a device-graph builder";
  let description = [{
    The device-graph counterpart of `mogg.call.execute`: invokes `build_graph`
    against a builder instead of `execute` against a context, recording a node
    rather than running the kernel. Produces no result; the enclosing
    `mgp.device_graph.dependencies` op orders nodes. Not a kernel terminator,
    and not wrapped in `mogg.with_trace`.

    `$hasEpilogueFusion` mirrors `mogg.call.opaque`: it is copied from the
    dispatch this call records and set the kernel's `has_epilogue_fusion`
    parameter, so a fused body reaches `build_graph` the same way it reaches
    `execute`.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    mogg.call.build_graph["linalg_kernels.__init__.Matmul"]
        inputs(%in, %wt : !mo.tensor<...>, !mo.tensor<...>)
        outputs(%out : !mo.tensor<...>)
        builder(%builder)

    // Lowered to
    Matmul.build_graph[...](out, in, wt, builder)
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    StrAttr:$kernelSymName,
    StrAttr:$moOpName,
    UnitAttr:$isThrows,
    Variadic<AnyTypeOf<[MOGG_Tensor, MOGG_Buffer, MOGG_Scalar, MOGG_Tuple,
                        MO_Opaque]>>:$inputs,
    Variadic<AnyTypeOf<[MOGG_Tensor, MOGG_Buffer, MOGG_Scalar, MOGG_Tuple,
                        MO_Opaque]>>:$outputs,
    MGP_DeviceGraphBuilderType:$graphBuilder,
    OptionalAttr<DictionaryAttr>:$kernel_param,
    DefaultValuedAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$hasEpilogueFusion
  );

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `[` $kernelSymName `]` `` custom<OptionalKernelParams>($kernel_param)
    (`inputs` `(` $inputs^ `:` qualified(type($inputs)) `)`)?
    (`outputs` `(` $outputs^ `:` qualified(type($outputs)) `)`)?
    `builder` `(` $graphBuilder `)`
    (`isThrows` $isThrows^)?
    `moOpName` `=` $moOpName
    (`hasEpilogueFusion` `=` $hasEpilogueFusion^)?
    attr-dict
  }];
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}


def MOGG_AsyncRoutineOp : MOGG_Op<"routine.async", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MGP_InOutSemanticsOpInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MGP_LiftableChainCreateOpInterface>,
  DeclInterface,
  IsolatedFromAbove,
  MO_ExplicitDevice,
  MO_HasDeviceInterface,
  SingleBlockImplicitTerminator<"MOGG::OutputOp">,
]> {
  let summary = "An abstract function representing a compiled body of code";
  let description = [{
    Takes and returns AsyncValues and runs its body to completion (always
    blocking). A generic form of mogg.routine; the first result is a mef.chain.

    Sequence fusion (concatenating code) fuses a parent region into a child:
    `canFuseIntoOther` allows this region as parent, `canBeFusedInto` as
    child. `canDuplicate` lets a region with several children be copied into
    each of them.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    Variadic<AnyType>:$operands,
    MO_ParamDecls:$outputParamDecls,
    M_InOutSignatureAttr:$inOutSignature,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_FusionInfoAttr>:$fusionInfo,
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<MOGG_DispatchKindAttr,
                              "::M::MOGG::DispatchKind::Immediate">:$dispatch,
    DefaultValuedAttr<ArrayAttr, "{}">:$constantResources,
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$canFuseIntoOther,
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$canBeFusedInto,
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$canDuplicate,
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$isStructured
  );
  let results = (outs Variadic<AnyType>:$results);
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let hasCanonicalizeMethod = 1;
  let hasVerifier = 1;

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    custom<ImmediateDispatch>($dispatch)
    custom<Kernel>($operands, type($operands), type($results), $body,
                   $outputParamDecls)
    custom<FusionInfo>($fusionInfo)
    (`canBeFusedInto` `=` $canBeFusedInto^)?
    (`canDuplicate` `=` $canDuplicate^)?
    (`canFuseIntoOther` `=` $canFuseIntoOther^)?
    (`constantResources` `=` $constantResources^)?
    `inOutSignature` `=` $inOutSignature
    (`isStructured` `=` $isStructured^)?
    attr-dict
  }];

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    /// Required by DeclInterface.
    ArrayRef<ParamDeclAttr> getInputParams() { return {}; }

    Block &getBodyBlock() { return getBody().front(); }

    MOGG::OutputOp getBodyTerminator();
  }];
}

def MOGG_GetDimOp : MOGG_Op<"get_dim", [Pure]> {
  let summary = "Returns the runtime representation of a dimension";

  let arguments = (ins Builtin_StringAttr:$dimension);
  let results = (outs DimensionType:$result);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    custom<Dim>($dimension) attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_ToMGPFromOpaqueOp : MOGG_Op<"to_mgp_from_opaque", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let arguments = (ins AnyType:$input);
  let results = (outs AnyType:$dataPointer);
  let summary = "Get the opaque pointer from the kgen value";
  let description = [{
    A no-op that keeps IR types correct while converting a KGEN opaque value
    (e.g. mo.opaque for graph outputs) to !mgp.opaque. Folds away when the
    types match.
  }];

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` operands `)` attr-dict `:`
        functional-type(operands, results)
  }];

  let hasFolder = 1;
}

def MOGG_ScratchPlaceholdersOp : MOGG_Op<"scratch_placeholders"> {
  let results = (outs Variadic<MO_Tensor>:$results);

  let summary = "Represents scratch buffer tensors that are not returned from the kernel";
  let description = [{
    Like `mogg.output_placeholders`, but the tensors are not returned from the
    kernel.

    Example:
    ```mlir
      %scratch = mogg.scratch_placeholders : !mo.tensor<[2, 3], f32>
    ```
  }];

  let assemblyFormat = [{
   attr-dict `:` type($results)
  }];
}

def MOGG_CompiledLoadOp : MOGG_LowerableOp<"compiled.load"> {
  let summary = "Loads pairs of (symbol, compiled object) into the runtime "
                "for a given device.";
  let description = [{
    Registers each symbol with its compiled-object blob in the runtime, for
    use by ops like `CompiledCallOp`. The object format and registration
    depend on the op's device.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    ArrayAttr:$symbols,
    ConfinedAttr<
      ElementsAttr,
      [AnyAttrOf<[Builtin_DenseResourceElementsAttr]>]
    >:$value,
    DefaultValuedAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$debuginfo
  );
}


def MOGG_CompiledCallOp : MOGG_Op<"compiled.call", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MemoryEffectsOpInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MO_ParamDeclaration>,
  MO_ExplicitDevice,
  MO_HasDeviceInterface,
]> {
  let summary = "Executes a compiled kernel on a given device.";
  let description = [{
    Looks up the compiled object (loaded by `CompiledLoadOp`) by name
    and calls it with the lowered operands.

    `usedParams` are the shape parameters the kernel uses; they are passed at
    runtime to reconstruct tensor shapes. `outputParamDecls` defines parameter
    values, which MGP translates into parameter system calls. `dispatch` says
    how the runtime schedules the call (see `MOGG_DispatchKind`).

    The kernel reads and writes memory its operands only point to, such as
    the buffer an init-block call fills, so the op is never pure: a call
    whose results are unused is not dead, and two identical calls are not
    redundant.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    Variadic<AnyType>:$operands,
    FlatSymbolRefAttr:$calleeSymbol,
    ArrayAttr:$usedParams,
    MO_ParamDecls:$outputParamDecls,
    OptionalAttr<MOGG_FusionInfoAttr>:$fusionInfo,
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<MOGG_DispatchKindAttr,
                              "::M::MOGG::DispatchKind::Immediate">:$dispatch,
    ArrayAttr:$constantResources
  );
  let results = (outs Variadic<AnyType>:$results);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $calleeSymbol `` custom<OutputParamDecls>($outputParamDecls)
    `` `(` $operands `)`
    custom<ImmediateDispatch>($dispatch)
    custom<FusionInfo>($fusionInfo)
    `constantResources` `=` $constantResources `,`
    `usedParams` `=` $usedParams
    attr-dict `:` functional-type($operands, $results)
  }];
}

def MOGG_FuncOp : MOGG_Op<"func", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
  FunctionOpInterface,
  IsolatedFromAbove,
  SingleBlockImplicitTerminator<"MOGG::OutputOp">,
  SymbolName,
  SymbolVisibility,
  Symbol,
]> {
  let summary = "Op that outlines a kernel";
  let description = [{
    A kernel that will be compiled to Mojo text.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins
    SymbolNameAttr:$sym_name,
    TypeAttrOf<FunctionType>:$function_type,
    MOGG_FusionInfoAttr:$fusionInfo,
    DefaultValuedOptionalAttr<MOGG_DispatchKindAttr,
                              "::M::MOGG::DispatchKind::Immediate">:$dispatch,
    DefaultValuedAttr<ArrayAttr, "{}">:$constantResources,
    MOGG_ABIKindAttr:$abi,
    // Execution-device label for each kernel's `target` parameter. A string
    // rather than `#M.device_ref` because only the label matters.
    StrAttr:$device,
    OptionalAttr<ArrayAttr>:$trait_stub_buffer_capture,
    OptionalAttr<ArrayAttr>:$trait_stub_arg_bounds,
    // Needed by -symbol-dce.
    DefaultValuedAttr<StrAttr, "\"private\"">:$sym_visibility
  );

  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);

  let hasCustomAssemblyFormat = 1;
  let hasVerifier = 1;

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    Block &getBodyBlock() { return getBody().front(); }
    OutputOp getBodyTerminator();
    Region *getCallableRegion() { return &getBodyRegion(); }
    ArrayRef<Type> getArgumentTypes() {
      return getFunctionType().getInputs();
    }
    ArrayRef<Type> getResultTypes() {
      return getFunctionType().getResults();
    }

    mlir::ArrayAttr getArgAttrsAttr() { return nullptr; }
    mlir::ArrayAttr getResAttrsAttr() { return nullptr; }
    void setArgAttrsAttr(mlir::ArrayAttr attrs){}
    void setResAttrsAttr(mlir::ArrayAttr attrs){}
    mlir::Attribute removeArgAttrsAttr() { return nullptr; }
    mlir::Attribute removeResAttrsAttr() { return nullptr; }

  private:
    mlir::LogicalResult emitMojoMGPABI(EmitMojoState &state);
    mlir::LogicalResult emitMojoMOGGABI(EmitMojoState &state);
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorInitOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor.__init__", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Represents the construction of a tensor";
  let description = [{
    Lowers to a ManagedTensorSlice constructor call from a data pointer and
    dimensions.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    MGP_DeviceBufferType:$buffer,
    Variadic<SI64Scalar>:$dims,
    BoolAttr:$mut,
    MO_IOKind:$io
  );
  let results = (outs AnyTypeOf<[MO_Tensor, MO_Buffer]>:$tensor);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $buffer (`,` $dims^)? `)` `io` `=` custom<IOKind>($io) `,` `mut` `=` $mut
    attr-dict `:` qualified(type($buffer)) `->` qualified(type($tensor))
  }];
}

def MOGG_TensorArgInitOp : MOGG_Op<"tensor_arg.__init__", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  AttrSizedOperandSegments,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Construct a trait-lane tensor argument from its contract";
  let description = [{
    Like `mogg.tensor.__init__`, but carries the `#mogg.tensor_arg` contract
    for an argument satisfying a kernel trait bound, instead of `{io, mut}`.
    `role`/`access` are read from the contract, not the result type.

    `$device_context` is for the GPU emit path and is not yet populated.
    `contract.fused` is currently always false and `contract.access` `none`.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    MGP_DeviceBufferType:$buffer,
    Variadic<SI64Scalar>:$dims,
    Optional<MOGG_Context>:$device_context,
    MOGG_TensorArgContractAttr:$contract
  );
  let results = (outs AnyTypeOf<[MO_Tensor, MO_Buffer]>:$tensor);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $buffer (`,` $dims^)? `)` (`context` `(` $device_context^ `)`)?
    `contract` `=` $contract
    attr-dict `:` qualified(type($buffer)) `->` qualified(type($tensor))
  }];
}

def MOGG_AsyncReadyOp : MOGG_Op<"async.ready", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let results = (outs ChainType:$output);

  let summary = "Represents a chain output placeholder";
  let description = [{
    Resolves chain dependencies for data-dependent operations and lets fusion
    elide chains when lowering to a compiled region.
  }];

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_AsyncJoinOp : MOGG_Op<"async.join", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
]> {
  let arguments = (ins Variadic<MOGG_TaskHandle>:$task_handles);

  let summary = "Waits for async task handles and raises on error";
  let description = [{
    Waits for all tasks, then raises the first error, if any. Has no results;
    use `mogg.async.ready` for the output chain.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    mogg.async.join(%t0, %t1)
    ```
  }];

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $task_handles `)` attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_AsyncUnpackOp : MOGG_Op<"async.unpack", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  InferTypeOpAdaptor,
  Pure,
  TypesMatchWith<"input is the async wrapper of the result",
                 /*lhs=*/"output", /*rhs=*/"input",
                 "::M::MOGG::AsyncType::get($_self)">,
]> {
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_Async:$input);
  let results = (outs AnyType:$output);
  let summary = "Unpacks an async value and returns it as sync";
  let description = [{
    Projects `!mogg.async<T>` (values outside a `mogg.routine.async`)
    to `T`. Inverse of `mogg.async.pack`. Only `T` is printed.
  }];

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $input `)` attr-dict `:` type($output)
  }];

  let hasFolder = 1;
}

def MOGG_AsyncPackOp : MOGG_Op<"async.pack", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
  TypesMatchWith<"result is the async wrapper of the input",
                 /*lhs=*/"input", /*rhs=*/"output",
                 "::M::MOGG::AsyncType::get($_self)">,
]> {
  let arguments = (ins AnyType:$input);
  let results = (outs MOGG_Async:$output);
  let summary = "Packs an sync value and returns it as async";
  let description = [{
    Inverse of `mogg.async.unpack`. Only `T` is printed.
  }];

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $input `)` attr-dict `:` type($input)
  }];

  let hasFolder = 1;
}

def MOGG_EmptyBufferOp : MOGG_Op<"empty_buffer", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Represents an empty buffer (actually of size 1) allocated on the stack";
  let description = [{
    Backs empty tensors passed to some kernels after fusion.
  }];

  let results = (outs MGP_DeviceBufferType:$result);

  let assemblyFormat = "attr-dict `:` qualified(type($result))";
}

def MOGG_YieldOp : MOGG_Op<"yield", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  ReturnLike,
  Terminator,
]> {
  let summary = "MOGG yield operation";
  let description = [{
    Yields the results of a mogg.try / except, the value a
    `mogg.tensor.create.prologue` body returns to the reading kernel, the
    value a compute `mogg.tensor.create.epilogue` body returns for the kernel
    to store, or an element's contribution to a `mogg.rowwise.reduce`.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins Variadic<AnyType>:$operands);
  let assemblyFormat = "attr-dict ($operands^ `:` type($operands))?";
}

def MOGG_WithTraceOp : MOGG_Op<"with_trace", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
]> {
  let summary = "Wraps a kernel terminator in a Trace context manager";
  let description = [{
    Models `with Trace[...]` around the KernelTerminator of a MOGG ABI stub.
    Always throwing because Trace.__enter__ raises.
  }];
  let results = (outs Variadic<AnyType>:$outputs);
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$body);
  let assemblyFormat = "$body attr-dict (`:` type($outputs)^)?";
}

def MOGG_ProfileScopeBeginOp : MOGG_Op<"profile_scope.begin", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
]> {
  let summary = "Opens a trace range for a Graph.profile_scope() span";
  let description = [{
    Lowers to `var t = Trace[...](name, color=...); t.start()`.

    A region-less sibling of `mogg.with_trace`: values defined inside a region
    would be invisible to later ops, and sequence-fused bodies have SSA values
    live across scope boundaries.

    `color` is set only when every covered op agrees on one (see
    `resolveProfileScopeColor`). Always throwing because `Trace.start()`
    raises.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins StrAttr:$name, OptionalAttr<StrAttr>:$color);
  let results = (outs MOGG_ProfileScopeRange:$range);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $name (`color` `=` $color^)? attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_ProfileScopeEndOp : MOGG_Op<"profile_scope.end", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
]> {
  let summary = "Closes the trace range opened by a `mogg.profile_scope.begin`";
  let description = [{
    Lowers to `t.end()`. Always throwing because `Trace.end()` raises.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_ProfileScopeRange:$range);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $range attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_RaiseOp : MOGG_Op<"raise", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
  Terminator,
]> {
  let summary = "Re-raises a kernel error with full context";
  let description = [{
    Terminates the except block of a MOGG ABI stub, adding the stub name,
    fusion info, and Python traceback to the error.
  }];
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_Error:$error);
  let assemblyFormat = "$error attr-dict";
}

def MOGG_TryOp : MOGG_Op<"try", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<OpAsmOpInterface, ["getAsmBlockArgumentNames"]>,
]> {
  let summary = "Op that represent a try / except statement";
  let description = [{
    The except region takes the raised `!mogg.error` as its only argument,
    printed as `except(%err)`.
  }];
  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$tryRegion, SizedRegion<1>:$exceptRegion);
  let results = (outs Variadic<AnyType>:$outputs);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $tryRegion custom<ExceptRegion>($exceptRegion)
    attr-dict `:` type($outputs)
  }];

  let hasCanonicalizer = 1;
}

def MOGG_AsyncErrorOp : MOGG_Op<"async.error", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let arguments = (ins MOGG_Error:$error);
  let results = (outs AnyType:$output);

  let summary = "Represents setting an error on a kernel output";
  let description = [{
    Sets an error on a chain or non-tensor output in a raising kernel's except
    block.

    ```
    mogg.try {
     ...
    } except(%err) {
      %chain = mogg.async.error %err : !mef.chain
      %dim0 = mogg.async.error %err : !si64
      mogg.yield %chain, %dim0
    }
    ```

    Lowers to `mogg_async_error_value`, returning an error `AnyAsyncValueRef`.
  }];

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $error attr-dict `:` type(results)
  }];
}

def MOGG_ShapeResultGetItemOp : MOGG_Op<"shape_result.__getitem__", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Gets a single dimension from a shape function result";
  let description = [{
    Example:
    ```
    %dim0 = mogg.shape_result.__getitem__(%shape, 0) : !mogg.shape_func_result<4>
    %dim1 = mogg.shape_result.__getitem__(%shape, 1) : !mogg.shape_func_result<4>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    MOGG_ShapeFuncResult:$shape,
    Builtin_IntegerAttr:$index
  );
  let results = (outs SI64Scalar:$result);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $shape `,` $index `)` attr-dict `:` qualified(type($shape))
  }];

  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

def MOGG_ShapeInitOp : MOGG_Op<"shape.__init__", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Construct a mojo shape object";
  let description = [{
    Builds an IndexList from the static shape attribute and its dynamic
    dimensions.

    Example:
    ```
      %shape = mogg.shape.__init__() <shape = #mosh<ape[1, 2, 3, 4]> : !mosh.ape>
      %dyn_shape = mogg.shape.__init__(%d0_val) <shape = #mosh<ape[2, D0, 3]> : !mosh.ape>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    Variadic<SI64Scalar>:$dynamic_dims,
    MOSH_ShapeAttr:$shape
  );
  let results = (outs MOGG_Shape:$result);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $dynamic_dims `)` `<` `shape` `=` qualified($shape) `>` attr-dict
  }];
}

def MOGG_ChainDummyOp : MOGG_Op<"chain.dummy", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Returns a chain to feed MRP primitives";
  let description = [{
    MGP primitives lowered into a kernel still consume a chain, which sequence
    fusion may turn into an intermediate result, so they are fed this no-op.
    TODO(GEX-2764): drop the chain from the signature when lowering instead.
  }];

  }];

def MOGG_ChainSinkOp : MOGG_Op<"chain.sink", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Consumes a chain and does nothing with it";
  let description = [{
    Keeps MGP primitives that lower to kernels from being DCE'd when their
    result has no consumer.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins ChainType:$chain);
  let results = (outs);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` $chain `)` attr-dict
  }];
