//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
//
// Lowers MO ops into `map` kernels. Each lowerable MO op with a registered
// Mojo kernel becomes either a `map.iter.opaque` wrapping a `map.call.opaque`
// to that kernel (with a trivial store epilogue per result), or, for
// elementwise kernels, a `map.iter.elementwise` expressing the loop body
// explicitly as scalar `map.load` / `map.call.elementwise` / `map.store` ops.
// A reduction monoid becomes a `map.iter.rowwise`.
// Contexts, variadics and scalars are materialized after fusion, not here.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#include "GraphCompiler/Conversion/MOToMAP/MOToMAP.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/Conversion/OperandInference.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/Conversion/ParameterInference.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MAPDialect/Dialect/MAPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MODialect.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOInterfaces.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MODialect/MOUtils.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/Analysis/KernelDeclAdaptor.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/Analysis/MojoRegistry.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/Analysis/Support.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/MOGGAttrs.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/Support/FusionUtils.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOSHDialect/MOSHAttrs.h"
#include "Support/ML/TensorShape.h"
#include "mlir/IR/Builders.h"

using namespace M;
using namespace mlir;

namespace M::MO {

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_MOTOMAP
#include "GraphCompiler/Conversion/MOToMAP/MOToMAP.h.inc"

namespace {

// The runtime tensor representation caps rank at `kMaxRank`
// (Support/ML/TensorShape.h); `MGP::TensorSpecType::get` asserts above it.
static bool hasLowerableRank(Operation *op) {
  auto rankOk = [](Type t) {
    MO::TensorType tt = MO::dynCastFromTensorLike(t);
    return !tt || !tt.hasRank() ||
           tt.getRank() <= static_cast<int64_t>(kMaxRank);
  };
  return llvm::all_of(op->getOperandTypes(), rankOk) &&
         llvm::all_of(op->getResultTypes(), rankOk);
}

bool shouldLower(Operation *op) {
  if (isa<MO::PreservedDuringKernelLowering>(op))
    return false;
  // No MAP form: returns by value. Lowered by MAPToMOGG.
  if (isa<MO::InvokeShapeFuncOp>(op))
    return false;
  Dialect *dialect = op->getDialect();
  if (!dialect || !isa<MO::MODialect>(dialect))
    return false;
  return hasLowerableRank(op);
}

MAP::IterEpilogueOp buildStoreEpilogue(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                       BlockArgument out) {
  auto outType = cast<MO::TensorType>(out.getType());
  auto indexType = MAP::IndexType::get(builder.getContext(), outType.getRank());

  // Pass a null `$intermediateTensor` explicitly; omitting it picks the
  // generic builder, which does not set `operandSegmentSizes`.
  // `AllocateAccumulatingBuffers` fills it in after fusion.
  auto epilogue =
      MAP::IterEpilogueOp::create(builder, loc, out.getType(), ValueRange{out},
                                  /*intermediateTensor=*/Value());

  OpBuilder::InsertionGuard guard(builder);
  Block *body = builder.createBlock(&epilogue.getBody());
  BlockArgument val = body->addArgument(outType.getElementType(), loc);
  BlockArgument idx = body->addArgument(indexType, loc);
  BlockArgument cap = body->addArgument(out.getType(), loc);
  builder.setInsertionPointToStart(body);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(builder, loc, /*tensor=*/cap, /*index=*/idx,
                       /*value=*/val);
  return epilogue;
}

MAP::IterPrologueOp buildLoadPrologue(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                      Value in) {
  auto inType = cast<MO::TensorType>(in.getType());
  auto indexType = MAP::IndexType::get(builder.getContext(), inType.getRank());

  auto prologue =
      MAP::IterPrologueOp::create(builder, loc, in.getType(), ValueRange{in});

  OpBuilder::InsertionGuard guard(builder);
  Block *body = builder.createBlock(&prologue.getBody());
  BlockArgument idx = body->addArgument(indexType, loc);
  BlockArgument cap = body->addArgument(in.getType(), loc);
  builder.setInsertionPointToStart(body);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(builder, loc, inType.getElementType(),
                                     /*tensor=*/cap, /*index=*/idx);
  MAP::YieldOp::create(builder, loc, loaded);
  return prologue;
}

// Effects for the replacing kernel to carry, instead of the conservative
// "unknown" default.
std::pair<bool, bool> getReadWriteEffects(Operation *op) {
  auto memEffectOp = dyn_cast<MemoryEffectOpInterface>(op);
  if (!memEffectOp)
    return {false, false};
  return {memEffectOp.hasEffect<MemoryEffects::Read>(),
          memEffectOp.hasEffect<MemoryEffects::Write>()};
}

template <typename OpT>
void stampAsyncLaunch(OpT iterOp, Operation *srcOp) {
  iterOp.setDispatch(MO::kernelRequiresSyncLaunch(srcOp)
                         ? MOGG::DispatchKind::Immediate
                         : MOGG::DispatchKind::Deferred);
}

FailureOr<Operation *>
lowerToOpaque(Operation *op, const MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor,
              const MOGG::KernelDeclOperandMapping &mapping) {
  llvm::DenseMap<uint64_t, bool> inputFusible;
  for (const auto &[idx, arg] : mapping.operandMapping)
    inputFusible[idx] = arg.isFusedTensorType();

  llvm::DenseMap<uint64_t, bool> outputFusible;
  for (const auto &[idx, arg] : mapping.resultMapping)
    outputFusible[idx] = arg.isFusedTensorType();

  OpBuilder builder(op);
  Location loc = op->getLoc();

  // A mutating op's chain is its last operand and last result.
  // `map.iter.opaque` threads it through `$inputChain` and a trailing result,
  // and keeps it out of the body: no kernel's `execute` reads it.
  ValueRange operands = op->getOperands();
  bool hasInputChain =
      !operands.empty() && isa<MO::ChainType>(operands.back().getType());
  Value inputChain = hasInputChain ? operands.back() : Value();
  ValueRange nonChainOperands = hasInputChain ? operands.drop_back() : operands;

  TypeRange resultTypes = op->getResultTypes();

  auto opaque = MAP::IterOpaqueOp::create(builder, loc, resultTypes,
                                          nonChainOperands, inputChain,
                                          /*fusionInfo=*/Attribute());
  // A collective executes on several devices, on which getDeviceOrDefaultAny
  // asserts. Take the first; the label only picks host or GPU codegen.
  // TODO(GEX-2278): carry all of them.
  DeviceRefAttr device;
  if (auto hasDevice = dyn_cast<MO::MOHasDeviceInterface>(op)) {
    SmallVector<DeviceRefAttr> devices = hasDevice.getExecutionDevices();
    if (!devices.empty())
      device = devices.front();
  }
  opaque.setDeviceRef(device ? device : MO::getDeviceOrDefaultAny(op));
  opaque.setFusionInfoAttr(
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(op->getContext(), MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  auto [hasReadEffect, hasWriteEffect] = getReadWriteEffects(op);
  opaque.setHasReadEffect(hasReadEffect);
  opaque.setHasWriteEffect(hasWriteEffect);
  stampAsyncLaunch(opaque, op);

  // Body block args shadow the non-chain inputs then the non-chain outputs.
  Block *body = builder.createBlock(&opaque.getBody());
  SmallVector<BlockArgument> ins;
  for (Value operand : nonChainOperands)
    ins.push_back(body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc));
  SmallVector<BlockArgument> outs;
  Type opaqueResultType;
  for (Type resultType : resultTypes) {
    if (isa<MO::ChainType>(resultType))
      continue;
    // A `!mo.opaque` result is returned by value and carried out by
    // `map.yield`, so it has no block argument.
    if (isa<MO::OpaqueType>(resultType)) {
      opaqueResultType = resultType;
      continue;
    }
    outs.push_back(body->addArgument(resultType, loc));
  }

  builder.setInsertionPointToStart(body);
  SmallVector<Value> callInputs;
  for (auto [idx, operand] : llvm::enumerate(ins)) {
    if (!inputFusible.lookup(idx)) {
      callInputs.push_back(operand);
      continue;
    }
    if (!isa<MO::TensorType>(operand.getType())) {
      op->emitOpError(
          "MOToMAP: input fusion is only supported for tensor operands");
      return failure();
    }
    callInputs.push_back(buildLoadPrologue(builder, loc, operand).getResult());
  }

  SmallVector<Value> callOutputs;
  for (auto [idx, out] : llvm::enumerate(outs)) {
    if (!outputFusible.lookup(idx)) {
      callOutputs.push_back(out);
      continue;
    }
    if (!isa<MO::TensorType>(out.getType())) {
      op->emitOpError(
          "MOToMAP: output fusion is only supported for tensor results");
      return failure();
    }
    callOutputs.push_back(buildStoreEpilogue(builder, loc, out).getResult());
  }

  // Parameters named only by opaque types (e.g.
  // `MakeSimdPair.execute[P0, P1]() -> SIMDPair[P0, P1]`).
  DictionaryAttr params = inferParameters(op, builder);
  if (adaptor.executeFunction && adaptor.executeFunction->attr) {
    SmallVector<NamedAttribute> withOpaque(params.begin(), params.end());
    MOGG::inferOpaqueParameters(withOpaque, op, *adaptor.executeFunction,
                                adaptor.executeFunction->attr.getParams());
    params = builder.getDictionaryAttr(withOpaque);
  }

  builder.setInsertionPointToEnd(body);
  auto callOp = MAP::CallOpaqueOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      opaqueResultType ? TypeRange{opaqueResultType} : TypeRange{},
      FlatSymbolRefAttr::get(op->getContext(),
                             adaptor.fullyResolvedName.strref()),
      adaptor.registeredOpName, params,
      /*inputs=*/callInputs,
      /*outputs=*/callOutputs);
  // Needed later to split the flat operands back into equal-length variadic
  // groups (e.g. a bundled collective's N peers and N signal buffers).
  callOp.setHasSameVariadicOperandSize(
      isa<MO::SameVariadicOperandSizeInterface>(op));

  // Only a by-value opaque result needs a terminator.
  if (opaqueResultType)
    MAP::YieldOp::create(builder, loc, callOp.getOpaqueResult());

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(opaque.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return opaque.getOperation();
}

// Lowers an elementwise MO op to a `map.iter.elementwise` expressing its loop
// body explicitly: one `map.load` per input, a `map.call.elementwise` call
// to the kernel's scalar function, and a `map.store` into the output, all
// indexed by the op's `map.index<N>` block argument.
LogicalResult
lowerElementwiseToForeach(Operation *op,
                          const MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor) {
  if (op->getNumResults() != 1)
    return op->emitOpError(
        "MOToMAP: elementwise op must have exactly one result");

  auto resultTensorTy = dyn_cast<MO::TensorType>(op->getResult(0).getType());
  if (!resultTensorTy)
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: elementwise op result must be !mo.tensor");

  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr = resultTensorTy.getShape();
  unsigned rank = static_cast<unsigned>(shapeAttr.getRank());
  Type elemTy = resultTensorTy.getElementType();

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{resultTensorTy},
      /*shape=*/shapeAttr,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input tensors..., output tensor, map.index<rank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(resultTensorTy, loc);
  body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument idxArg = body->getArguments().back();

  SmallVector<Value> scalarLoads;
  for (auto [i, operand] : llvm::enumerate(op->getOperands())) {
    BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(i);
    auto inputTensorTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(operand.getType());
    Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
        bodyBuilder, loc, inputTensorTy.getElementType(), inputArg, idxArg);
    scalarLoads.push_back(loaded);
  }

  auto kernelSymbol =
      FlatSymbolRefAttr::get(ctx, adaptor.fullyResolvedName.strref());
  DictionaryAttr params = inferParameters(op, builder);
  if (params.empty())
    params = nullptr;
  Value scalar = MAP::CallElementwiseOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, elemTy, kernelSymbol, params, idxArg, scalarLoads);

  BlockArgument outputArg =
      body->getArgument(static_cast<unsigned>(op->getNumOperands()));
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, scalar);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.mutable.store to a map.iter.elementwise that `map.store`s directly
// into its buffer input and threads a chain in and out. Its elementwise
// function is a scalar identity (gather_scatter.mojo's MutableStore).
// Special-cased by identity, as there is no generic mechanism (GEX-2360).
LogicalResult
lowerMutableStoreToForeach(MO::MutableStoreOp op,
                           const MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  MO::TensorType bufferAsTensorTy = op.getInBuffer().getType().toTensorType();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr = bufferAsTensorTy.getShape();
  unsigned rank = static_cast<unsigned>(shapeAttr.getRank());
  Type elemTy = bufferAsTensorTy.getElementType();

  auto [hasReadEffect, hasWriteEffect] = getReadWriteEffects(op);

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{MO::ChainType::get(ctx)},
      /*shape=*/shapeAttr,
      /*inputs=*/ValueRange{op.getInTensor(), op.getInBuffer()},
      /*chain=*/op.getInChain(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)),
      /*hasReadEffect=*/hasReadEffect,
      /*hasWriteEffect=*/hasWriteEffect);
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [tensor value, buffer, map.index<rank>]; the buffer is
  // the store target.
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  BlockArgument valueArg = body->addArgument(op.getInTensor().getType(), loc);
  BlockArgument bufferArg = body->addArgument(op.getInBuffer().getType(), loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg = body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  Value loaded =
      MAP::LoadOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, elemTy, valueArg, idxArg);

  auto kernelSymbol =
      FlatSymbolRefAttr::get(ctx, adaptor.fullyResolvedName.strref());
  DictionaryAttr params = inferParameters(op, builder);
  if (params.empty())
    params = nullptr;
  Value scalar =
      MAP::CallElementwiseOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, elemTy, kernelSymbol,
                                     params, idxArg, ValueRange{loaded});

  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, bufferArg, idxArg, scalar);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.slice to a map.iter.elementwise over the *output* shape (the "pull"
// model): the body computes the input index via map.index.slice, loads, and
// stores unchanged.
LogicalResult lowerSliceToForeach(MO::SliceOp op) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getInput().getType());
  auto outputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getResult().getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape = inputTy.getShape();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape = outputTy.getShape();
  if (inShape.getRank() != outShape.getRank())
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: slice must preserve rank");
  int64_t rank = outShape.getRank();

  // MO tracks constness per tensor, not per dimension.
  auto boundsOrDynamic = [&](Value v) {
    if (auto constVec = MO::tryGetConstantIntVector(cast<MO::TensorValue>(v)))
      return mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, *constVec);
    return mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(
        ctx, SmallVector<int64_t>(rank, ShapedType::kDynamic));
  };

  SmallVector<int64_t> inDims = inShape.getIntDims();
  SmallVector<int64_t> starts(boundsOrDynamic(op.getStart()).asArrayRef());
  SmallVector<int64_t> stops(boundsOrDynamic(op.getStop()).asArrayRef());
  SmallVector<int64_t> steps(boundsOrDynamic(op.getStep()).asArrayRef());

  // Normalize Python-style negative and out-of-range bounds, matching
  // materializeSliceShape's clamp.
  for (int64_t i = 0; i < rank; ++i) {
    if (ShapedType::isDynamic(inDims[i]) || ShapedType::isDynamic(steps[i]) ||
        steps[i] == 0)
      continue;
    int64_t dim = inDims[i];
    // A reverse slice walks down to -1, so it clamps one below the forward
    // range.
    int64_t lo = steps[i] > 0 ? 0 : -1;
    int64_t hi = steps[i] > 0 ? dim : dim - 1;
    auto normalize = [&](int64_t v) {
      if (ShapedType::isDynamic(v))
        return v;
      return std::clamp<int64_t>(v < 0 ? v + dim : v, lo, hi);
    };
    starts[i] = normalize(starts[i]);
    stops[i] = normalize(stops[i]);
  }

  // Verify first: `get` asserts on a rejected spec.
  auto emitSliceError = [&] { return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: "); };
  if (failed(MAP::SliceSpecAttr::verify(
          emitSliceError, MAP::ViewSignatureAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape),
          mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, starts),
          mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, stops),
          mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, steps))))
    return failure();

  auto spec =
      MAP::SliceSpecAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape, starts, stops, steps);

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{outputTy},
      /*shape=*/outShape,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, start, stop, step, output, map.index<rank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(outputTy, loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg = body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(0);
  BlockArgument startsArg = body->getArgument(1);
  BlockArgument stopsArg = body->getArgument(2);
  BlockArgument stepsArg = body->getArgument(3);
  BlockArgument outputArg = body->getArgument(4);

  Value innerIdx = MAP::SliceIndexOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), spec, idxArg, startsArg,
      stopsArg, stepsArg);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, outputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, innerIdx);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, loaded);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.static.broadcast_to like lowerSliceToForeach, via
// map.index.broadcast. Broadcast can add rank, so the load index rank may
// differ from the loop's.
LogicalResult lowerBroadcastToForeach(Static::BroadcastToOp op) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getInput().getType());
  auto outputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getResult().getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape = inputTy.getShape();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape = outputTy.getShape();
  if (inShape.getRank() > outShape.getRank())
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: broadcast cannot reduce rank");
  int64_t inRank = inShape.getRank();
  int64_t outRank = outShape.getRank();

  auto spec = MAP::BroadcastSpecAttr::get(
      ctx, MAP::ViewSignatureAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape));

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{outputTy},
      /*shape=*/outShape,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, output, map.index<outRank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(outputTy, loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg =
      body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, outRank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(0);
  BlockArgument outputArg = body->getArgument(1);

  Value innerIdx = MAP::BroadcastIndexOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, inRank), spec, idxArg);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, outputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, innerIdx);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, loaded);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.static.reshape like lowerSliceToForeach, via map.index.reshape.
// Rank may change in either direction.
LogicalResult lowerReshapeToForeach(MO::Static::ReshapeOp op) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getInput().getType());
  auto outputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getResult().getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape = inputTy.getShape();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape = outputTy.getShape();
  int64_t inRank = inShape.getRank();
  int64_t outRank = outShape.getRank();

  auto spec = MAP::ReshapeSpecAttr::get(
      ctx, MAP::ViewSignatureAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape));

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{outputTy},
      /*shape=*/outShape,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, output, map.index<outRank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(outputTy, loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg =
      body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, outRank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(0);
  BlockArgument outputArg = body->getArgument(1);

  Value innerIdx = MAP::ReshapeIndexOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, inRank), spec, idxArg);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, outputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, innerIdx);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, loaded);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers mo.transpose like lowerSliceToForeach, via map.index.transpose. The
// perm is a runtime operand, also baked into `spec` when constant; otherwise
// (the eager interpreter's one-graph-per-op transpose) `spec` is all-dynamic.
LogicalResult lowerTransposeToForeach(MO::TransposeOp op) {
  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getInput().getType());
  auto outputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(op.getResult().getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr inShape = inputTy.getShape();
  MOSH::ShapeAttr outShape = outputTy.getShape();
  if (inShape.getRank() != outShape.getRank())
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: transpose must preserve rank");
  int64_t rank = outShape.getRank();

  auto permAttr = mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(
      ctx, SmallVector<int64_t>(rank, ShapedType::kDynamic));
  if (auto permVec =
          MO::tryGetConstantIntVector(cast<MO::TensorValue>(op.getPerm())))
    permAttr = mlir::DenseI64ArrayAttr::get(ctx, *permVec);

  auto spec = MAP::TransposeSpecAttr::get(
      ctx, MAP::ViewSignatureAttr::get(ctx, inShape, outShape), permAttr);

  auto foreachOp = MAP::IterElementwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc,
      /*resultTypes=*/SmallVector<Type>{outputTy},
      /*shape=*/outShape,
      /*inputs=*/op->getOperands(),
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      /*fusionInfo=*/
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(foreachOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, perm, output, map.index<rank>].
  Block *body = &foreachOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  for (Value operand : op->getOperands())
    body->addArgument(operand.getType(), loc);
  body->addArgument(outputTy, loc);
  BlockArgument idxArg = body->addArgument(MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), loc);

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->getArgument(0);
  BlockArgument permArg = body->getArgument(1);
  BlockArgument outputArg = body->getArgument(2);

  Value innerIdx = MAP::TransposeIndexOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, rank), spec, idxArg, permArg);
  Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, outputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, innerIdx);
  MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, idxArg, loaded);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(foreachOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// Lowers a reduction monoid to a `map.iter.rowwise`: one fold over the input,
// then a per-row store of each output field. Expects a verified reduction.
LogicalResult lowerReductionToRowwise(Operation *op,
                                      const MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor) {
  ErrorOr<int64_t> axis =
      MO::getReductionAxis(op->getOperand(0), op->getResultTypes());
  if (axis.isError())
    return op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: reduction ") << axis.getError();

  MLIRContext *ctx = op->getContext();
  Location loc = op->getLoc();
  OpBuilder builder(op);

  Value input = op->getOperand(0);
  auto inputTy = cast<MO::TensorType>(input.getType());
  MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr = inputTy.getShape();
  auto indexTy = MAP::IndexType::get(ctx, shapeAttr.getRank());

  auto rowwiseOp = MAP::IterRowwiseOp::create(
      builder, loc, op->getResultTypes(), shapeAttr,
      builder.getI64IntegerAttr(*axis), ValueRange{input},
      /*chain=*/Value(),
      MOGG::FusionInfoAttr::get(ctx, MOGG::createFusionLeaf(op)));
  stampAsyncLaunch(rowwiseOp, op);

  // Body block args: [input, outputs..., row].
  Block *body = &rowwiseOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
  BlockArgument inputArg = body->addArgument(inputTy, loc);
  SmallVector<BlockArgument> outputArgs;
  for (Type resultTy : op->getResultTypes())
    outputArgs.push_back(body->addArgument(resultTy, loc));
  BlockArgument rowArg = body->addArgument(indexTy, loc);

  SmallVector<Type> foldTypes;
  for (Type resultTy : op->getResultTypes())
    foldTypes.push_back(cast<MO::TensorType>(resultTy).getElementType());

  OpBuilder bodyBuilder = OpBuilder::atBlockEnd(body);
  auto reduceOp = MAP::IterReduceOp::create(
      bodyBuilder, loc, foldTypes,
      FlatSymbolRefAttr::get(ctx, adaptor.fullyResolvedName.strref()));
  {
    OpBuilder::InsertionGuard guard(bodyBuilder);
    Block *foldBody = &reduceOp.getBody().emplaceBlock();
    BlockArgument idxArg = foldBody->addArgument(indexTy, loc);
    bodyBuilder.setInsertionPointToEnd(foldBody);
    Value loaded = MAP::LoadOp::create(
        bodyBuilder, loc, inputTy.getElementType(), inputArg, idxArg);
    MAP::YieldOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, loaded);
  }

  for (auto [outputArg, field] :
       llvm::zip_equal(outputArgs, reduceOp.getResults()))
    MAP::StoreOp::create(bodyBuilder, loc, outputArg, rowArg, field);

  op->replaceAllUsesWith(rowwiseOp.getResults());
  op->erase();
  return success();
}

// See `lowerMOOpToMAP`.
FailureOr<Operation *> lowerOp(Operation *op, MOGG::MojoRegistry &registry) {
  ErrorOr<MOGG::KernelDeclAdaptor> adaptor =
      MOGG::getMojoKernelAdaptor(registry, op);
  if (adaptor.isError())
    return nullptr;

  if (auto mutableStoreOp = dyn_cast<MO::MutableStoreOp>(op)) {
    if (failed(lowerMutableStoreToForeach(mutableStoreOp, *adaptor)))
      return failure();
    return nullptr;
  }

  // Reductions have no executeFunction either.
  if (adaptor->isReduction()) {
    if (failed(lowerReductionToRowwise(op, *adaptor)))
      return failure();
    return nullptr;
  }

  // Elementwise kernels have no executeFunction.
  if (adaptor->isElementwise()) {
    if (failed(lowerElementwiseToForeach(op, *adaptor)))
      return failure();
    return nullptr;
  }

  if (!adaptor->executeFunction) {
    op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: kernel has no execute function");
    return failure();
  }

  ErrorOr<MOGG::KernelDeclOperandMapping> mapping =
      MOGG::mapMOOpToKernelImplementation(op, *adaptor->executeFunction);
  if (mapping.isError()) {
    op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: failed to map operands to kernel");
    return failure();
  }

  LogicalResult foreachResult = success();
  if (isa<MO::InvokeShapeFuncOp>(op)) {
    op->emitOpError("MOToMAP: shape-function kernels are not yet supported");
    return failure();
  } else if (auto sliceOp = dyn_cast<MO::SliceOp>(op)) {
    foreachResult = lowerSliceToForeach(sliceOp);
  } else if (auto broadcastOp = dyn_cast<MO::Static::BroadcastToOp>(op)) {
    foreachResult = lowerBroadcastToForeach(broadcastOp);
  } else if (auto reshapeOp = dyn_cast<MO::Static::ReshapeOp>(op)) {
    foreachResult = lowerReshapeToForeach(reshapeOp);
  } else if (auto transposeOp = dyn_cast<MO::TransposeOp>(op)) {
    foreachResult = lowerTransposeToForeach(transposeOp);
  } else {
    return lowerToOpaque(op, *adaptor, *mapping);
  }

  if (failed(foreachResult))
    return failure();
  return nullptr;
}

struct MOToMAPPass : public M::MO::impl::MOToMAPBase<MOToMAPPass> {
  using Base::Base;

  void runOnOperation() override {
    MOGG::MojoRegistry registry(getOperation());

    SmallVector<Operation *> worklist;
    WalkResult walkResult = getOperation()->walk([&](Operation *op) {
      Dialect *dialect = op->getDialect();
      if (dialect && isa<MO::MODialect>(dialect) && !hasLowerableRank(op)) {
        op->emitError() << "'" << op->getName().getStringRef()
                        << "' op has a tensor whose rank exceeds the maximum "
                           "supported rank of "
                        << kMaxRank << "; the graph cannot be lowered";
        return WalkResult::interrupt();
      }
      if (shouldLower(op))
        worklist.push_back(op);
      return WalkResult::advance();
    });
    if (walkResult.wasInterrupted())
      return signalPassFailure();

    for (Operation *op : worklist)
      if (failed(lowerOp(op, registry)))
        return signalPassFailure();
  }
};

} // namespace

FailureOr<Operation *> lowerMOOpToMAP(Operation *op,
                                      MOGG::MojoRegistry &registry) {
  return lowerOp(op, registry);
}

using namespace mlir;

namespace M {

Attribute normalizeKernelParameter(Attribute value) {
  if (auto vectorAttr = dyn_cast<DenseIntElementsAttr>(value)) {
    SmallVector<Attribute> intAttrs;
    for (const APInt &intVal : vectorAttr.getValues<APInt>())
      intAttrs.push_back(IntegerAttr::get(
          IntegerType::get(vectorAttr.getContext(), intVal.getBitWidth()),
          intVal));
    return ArrayAttr::get(vectorAttr.getContext(), intAttrs);
  }
  if (auto typeAttr = dyn_cast<TypeAttr>(value))
    return KGEN::DTypeConstantAttr::get(
        typeAttr.getContext(), MO::getDTypeOrInvalid(typeAttr.getValue()));
  // An enum attribute is not a `TypedAttr`; kernels take the raw value.
  if (auto coord = dyn_cast<MO::CoordinateTransformModeAttr>(value))
    return IntegerAttr::get(IndexType::get(coord.getContext()),
                            static_cast<int64_t>(coord.getValue()));
  return value;
}

// Already the kernel's parameters: nothing to select, only spellings to fix.
static DictionaryAttr normalizeParameterDict(DictionaryAttr params,
                                             OpBuilder &builder) {
  if (!params)
    return builder.getDictionaryAttr({});
  SmallVector<NamedAttribute> normalized;
  for (NamedAttribute attr : params)
    normalized.push_back(NamedAttribute(
        attr.getName(), normalizeKernelParameter(attr.getValue())));
  return builder.getDictionaryAttr(normalized);
}

DictionaryAttr inferParameters(Operation *op, OpBuilder &builder) {
  if (auto custom = dyn_cast<MO::CustomOp>(op))
    return normalizeParameterDict(custom.getParameters(), builder);

  // `kgenParams` is not a `TypedAttr`, so the scrape below would drop it.
  if (auto layoutTransform = dyn_cast<MO::LayoutTransformOp>(op))
    return normalizeParameterDict(layoutTransform.getKgenParamsAttr(), builder);

  SmallVector<NamedAttribute> params;
  for (NamedAttribute attr : op->getAttrs()) {
    Attribute value = attr.getValue();
    if (isa<M::DeviceRefAttr, KGEN::ParamDeclArrayAttr>(value))
      continue;
    // An all-integer `ArrayAttr` (e.g. a fused slice's `static_starts`) is not
    // a `TypedAttr`, but is a valid comptime `IntTuple` kernel parameter.
    if (auto arrayAttr = dyn_cast<ArrayAttr>(value)) {
      if (llvm::all_of(arrayAttr,
                       [](Attribute a) { return isa<IntegerAttr>(a); }))
        params.push_back(NamedAttribute(attr.getName(), value));
      continue;
    }
    // Not `TypedAttr`s, but the normalizer knows how to spell them.
    if (!isa<TypedAttr, TypeAttr, MO::CoordinateTransformModeAttr>(value))
      continue;
    params.push_back(
        NamedAttribute(attr.getName(), normalizeKernelParameter(value)));
  }
  appendStaticOperandParameters(op, builder, params);
  return builder.getDictionaryAttr(params);
}

// TODO(GEX-2177): Remove this by adding an opt-in in the implementation and
// generically supporting static values in kernels.
void appendStaticOperandParameters(Operation *op, OpBuilder &builder,
                                   SmallVectorImpl<NamedAttribute> &params) {
  auto extractConstantValues = [&](Value ssaValue, StringLiteral paramName) {
    SmallVector<int64_t> values;
    auto asTensor = cast<MO::TensorValue>(ssaValue);
    if (auto maybeIntVec = tryGetConstantIntVector(asTensor)) {
      values = std::move(*maybeIntVec);
    } else if (auto maybeIntScalar = tryGetConstantInt(asTensor)) {
      values.push_back(*maybeIntScalar);
    } else {
      MO::TensorType t = asTensor.getType();
      if (t.hasStaticShape()) {
        int64_t numElems = *t.getNumElements();
        values.append(numElems, ShapedType::kDynamic);
      } else {
        values.push_back(ShapedType::kDynamic);
      }
    }

    params.push_back(NamedAttribute(builder.getStringAttr(paramName),
                                    builder.getI64ArrayAttr(values)));
  };
  if (auto convOp = dyn_cast<MO::ConvOp>(op)) {
    extractConstantValues(convOp.getStrides(),
                          MOGG::PARAMETER_CONV_STATIC_STRIDES);
    extractConstantValues(convOp.getDilations(),
                          MOGG::PARAMETER_CONV_STATIC_DILATIONS);
    extractConstantValues(convOp.getPaddings(),
                          MOGG::PARAMETER_CONV_STATIC_PADDING);
  } else if (auto transposeOp = dyn_cast<MO::TransposeOp>(op)) {
    extractConstantValues(transposeOp.getPerm(),
                          MOGG::PARAMETER_TRANSPOSE_STATIC_PERM);
  } else if (auto sliceOp = dyn_cast<MO::SliceOp>(op)) {
    extractConstantValues(sliceOp.getStart(),
                          MOGG::PARAMETER_SLICE_STATIC_STARTS);
    extractConstantValues(sliceOp.getStep(),
                          MOGG::PARAMETER_SLICE_STATIC_STEPS);
  }
}

/// Resolves kernel parameters (P0, P1, ...) from the opaque type parameters
/// (S0, S1, ...) on operands and results, via the kernel's annotations:
///   mogg.value_params: [{S0 = #kgen.param.decl.ref<P0>, ...}, ...]
///   mogg.value_result_params: [{S0 = #kgen.param.decl.ref<P0>, ...}]
void inferOpaqueParameters(SmallVectorImpl<NamedAttribute> &forwardedParameters,
                           Operation *moOp,
                           const KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor &function,
                           mlir::ArrayAttr inputParams) {
  auto inputParamsAttr = function.attr.getArgParams();
  auto resultParamsAttr = function.attr.getResultParams();

  // Explicitly declared parameters only (e.g. "P0" from "[P0: Int]"); a
  // backtick marks an inferred one (e.g. "S1`2x1" from a "_" placeholder).
  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> declaredParams;
  if (inputParams) {
    for (auto paramAttr : inputParams) {
      if (auto param = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr>(paramAttr)) {
        StringRef paramName = param.getName();
        if (!paramName.contains('`'))
          declaredParams.insert(paramName);
      }
    }
  }

  auto inferFromOpaque = [&](DictionaryAttr kernelParamDict,
                             MO::OpaqueType opaqueType) {
    if (!kernelParamDict || !opaqueType)
      return;

    DictionaryAttr opaqueParams = opaqueType.getParameters();
    if (!opaqueParams)
      return;

    for (NamedAttribute kernelParam : kernelParamDict) {
      auto declRef = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>(kernelParam.getValue());
      if (!declRef)
        continue;

      StringRef paramName = declRef.getName();
      if (!declaredParams.contains(paramName))
        continue;

      // Same key as in the opaque type (e.g. "S0").
      auto opaqueValue = opaqueParams.getNamed(kernelParam.getName());
      if (!opaqueValue)
        continue;

      auto typedValue = dyn_cast<TypedAttr>(opaqueValue->getValue());
      if (!typedValue)
        continue;

      forwardedParameters.push_back(
          NamedAttribute(declRef.getName(), typedValue));
    }
  };

  // Kernel arguments list DPS outputs first, then inputs; MO operands are
  // only the inputs.
  if (inputParamsAttr) {
    unsigned numDpsOutputs =
        static_cast<unsigned>(function.outputArguments.size());

    for (auto [idx, operand] : llvm::enumerate(moOp->getOperands())) {
      unsigned kernelArgIdx = idx + numDpsOutputs;
      if (kernelArgIdx >= inputParamsAttr.size())
        break;

      auto opaqueType = dyn_cast<MO::OpaqueType>(operand.getType());
      if (!opaqueType)
        continue;

      auto kernelParamDict =
          dyn_cast<DictionaryAttr>(inputParamsAttr[kernelArgIdx]);
      inferFromOpaque(kernelParamDict, opaqueType);
    }
  }

  if (!resultParamsAttr)
    return;

  for (auto [idx, result] : llvm::enumerate(moOp->getResults())) {
    if (idx >= resultParamsAttr.size())
      break;

    auto opaqueType = dyn_cast<MO::OpaqueType>(result.getType());
    if (!opaqueType)
      continue;

    auto kernelParamDict = dyn_cast<DictionaryAttr>(resultParamsAttr[idx]);
    inferFromOpaque(kernelParamDict, opaqueType);
  }
}

/// Removes parameters from inferByInputs that appear in the function's result
/// type but not in its input argument types.
static void removeResultOnlyParams(KGEN::LIT::FnTypeGeneratorType sig,
                                   llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> &inferByInputs) {
  SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr> resultParamRefs;
  bool hasConstExpr = false;
  size_t requiredSignatureDepth = 0;
  Type userResultType = sig.getUserResultType();
  KGEN::collectParameterReferences(userResultType, resultParamRefs,
                                   hasConstExpr, requiredSignatureDepth);
  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> resultParams;
  for (auto paramRef : resultParamRefs)
    resultParams.insert(paramRef.getName().getValue());

  // Excludes the byref result slot.
  ArrayRef<Type> argTypes = sig.getArguments();
  if (sig.hasMemoryOnlyResult())
    argTypes = argTypes.drop_back();
  if (sig.isThrows())
    argTypes = argTypes.drop_back();

  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> inputParams;
  for (Type argType : argTypes) {
    SmallVector<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr> argParamRefs;
    KGEN::collectParameterReferences(argType, argParamRefs, hasConstExpr,
                                     requiredSignatureDepth);
    for (auto paramRef : argParamRefs)
      inputParams.insert(paramRef.getName().getValue());
  }

  SmallVector<StringRef> toRemove;
  for (StringRef paramName : inferByInputs) {
    if (resultParams.contains(paramName) && !inputParams.contains(paramName))
      toRemove.push_back(paramName);
  }
  for (StringRef paramName : toRemove)
    inferByInputs.erase(paramName);
}

/// Shared by all inferKernelParameters overloads.
static ErrorOr<InferredParameters>
inferParameters(ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> fnLevelParams,
                ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> structLevelParams,
                mlir::ArrayAttr inputParamMappings,
                mlir::DictionaryAttr defaultAttrs,
                KGEN::LIT::FnTypeGeneratorType sig,
                std::function<ErrorOr<MojoValue>(StringRef)> &inferCallback) {

  // A param is inferable from inputs when an argument type references it, as
  // a `ParamDeclRefAttr` or a depth-0 `ParamIndexRefAttr` (elaborated
  // bytecode's form). An IndexRef `*(0, K)` indexes the generator's full
  // parameter list, laid out as `structLevelParams + fnLevelParams`, so look
  // it up in the merged list; `fnLevelParams` alone would name the wrong
  // param.
  llvm::SmallVector<mlir::Attribute> mergedParams;
  mergedParams.reserve(structLevelParams.size() + fnLevelParams.size());
  mergedParams.append(structLevelParams.begin(), structLevelParams.end());
  mergedParams.append(fnLevelParams.begin(), fnLevelParams.end());

  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> inferByInputs;
  std::function<void(mlir::Attribute)> walkAttr;
  std::function<void(mlir::Type)> walkType;
  walkAttr = [&](mlir::Attribute attr) {
    if (!attr)
      return;
    if (auto sugar = dyn_cast<KGEN::SugarAttr>(attr)) {
      walkAttr(sugar.getCanonical());
      return;
    }
    if (auto declRef = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamDeclRefAttr>(attr)) {
      inferByInputs.insert(declRef.getName().getValue());
      return;
    }
    if (auto indexRef = dyn_cast<KGEN::ParamIndexRefAttr>(attr)) {
      if (indexRef.getDepth() == 0 &&
          indexRef.getIndex() < mergedParams.size()) {
        auto pd = cast<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr>(mergedParams[indexRef.getIndex()]);
        inferByInputs.insert(pd.getName().getValue());
      }
      return;
    }
    attr.walkImmediateSubElements([&](mlir::Attribute a) { walkAttr(a); },
                                  [&](mlir::Type t) { walkType(t); });
  };
  walkType = [&](mlir::Type type) {
    if (!type)
      return;
    type.walkImmediateSubElements([&](mlir::Attribute a) { walkAttr(a); },
                                  [&](mlir::Type t) { walkType(t); });
  };
  for (size_t i = 0, n = sig.getNumArguments(); i < n; ++i)
    walkType(sig.getArgument(i));

  removeResultOnlyParams(sig, inferByInputs);

  // Infer-only parameters (declared before `//`) are left for Mojo to infer
  // at the call. The walk above can miss one: a `TypeList` that a
  // `xs: TensorTuple[*Ts]` argument unpacks is referenced only through its
  // values.
  llvm::DenseSet<StringRef> inferOnly;
  if (KGEN::PogListAttr pogs = sig.getParamListAttrs())
    for (size_t i = 0, n = pogs.size(); i < n; ++i)
      if (pogs.getPassingKind(i) == KGEN::PassingKind::Inferred)
        inferOnly.insert(pogs.getName(i).getValue());

  auto isIOSpecType = [](Type ty) {
    auto structType = dyn_cast<KGEN::LIT::StructType>(ty);
    return structType &&
           isMojoIOSpecTypeName(structType.getSymbol().getNestedReferences());
  };

  auto inferParametersInner =
      [&](ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> params,
          SmallVector<MojoValue> &inferredParams) -> ErrorOrSuccess {
    for (auto paramAttr : params) {
      auto param = cast<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr>(paramAttr);
      StringRef paramName = param.getName().getValue();

      if (isa<KGEN::LIT::OriginType>(param.getType()) ||
          isIOSpecType(param.getType()))
        continue;
      if (paramName.contains("."))
        continue;

      ErrorOr<MojoValue> maybeVal = inferCallback(paramName);
      if ((inferByInputs.contains(paramName) ||
           inferOnly.contains(paramName)) &&
          maybeVal.isError())
        continue;

      if (maybeVal.isError()) {
        if (defaultAttrs && defaultAttrs.contains(paramName))
          continue;
        return maybeVal.takeError();
      }
      inferredParams.push_back(MojoValue(paramName).equal(*maybeVal));
    }
    return success();
  };

  InferredParameters ret;
  auto errOr = inferParametersInner(fnLevelParams, ret.functionParameters);
  if (errOr.isError())
    return errOr.takeError();
  errOr = inferParametersInner(structLevelParams, ret.structParameters);
  if (errOr.isError())
    return errOr.takeError();
  return ret;
}

// {param-name -> UnitAttr} for fn-level params with a declared default, from
// the function's `PogListAttr`; such params may fail to infer.
static mlir::DictionaryAttr
computeDefaultParamsDict(KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor *fnAdaptor) {
  if (!fnAdaptor || !fnAdaptor->attr.getParams() ||
      fnAdaptor->attr.getParams().empty())
    return nullptr;
  auto fnParams = fnAdaptor->attr.getParams().getValue();
  KGEN::PogListAttr pogs = fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getParamListAttrs();
  size_t numImplicit =
      fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getNumImplicitOriginDecls();
  size_t totalPogs = pogs.getPogs().size();
  // Fn-level params are at the end of the merged pog list (struct-level
  // params come first).
  size_t fnStart =
      totalPogs >= fnParams.size() ? totalPogs - fnParams.size() : 0;
  size_t fnEnd =
      fnParams.size() > numImplicit ? fnParams.size() - numImplicit : 0;

  mlir::Builder builder(fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getContext());
  mlir::NamedAttrList defaultNames;
  for (size_t fnIdx = 0; fnIdx < fnEnd; ++fnIdx) {
    size_t pogIdx = fnStart + fnIdx;
    if (pogIdx >= totalPogs || !pogs.getDefault(pogIdx))
      continue;
    auto paramDecl = mlir::cast<KGEN::ParamDeclAttr>(fnParams[fnIdx]);
    defaultNames.append(
        mlir::StringAttr::get(
            fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getContext(),
            KGEN::demangleParameterName(paramDecl.getName().strref())),
        builder.getUnitAttr());
  }
  if (defaultNames.empty())
    return nullptr;
  return mlir::DictionaryAttr::get(fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature().getContext(),
                                   defaultNames.getAttrs());
}

ErrorOr<InferredParameters> inferKernelParameters(
    KernelDeclAdaptor &adaptor, llvm::StringRef funcLabel,
    std::function<ErrorOr<MojoValue>(StringRef)> &&inferCallback) {
  KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor *fnAdaptor =
      const_cast<KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor *>(
          adaptor.getFunctionByLabel(funcLabel));
  ASSERT_STREAM(fnAdaptor,
                "Function label '" << funcLabel << "' not found in adaptor");

  // Each variant (execute / elementwise / shape / build_graph) has its own
  // param list, since signatures differ (e.g. elementwise omits
  // `target`/`_trace_name`).
  ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> fnParams;
  if (fnAdaptor->attr.getParams())
    fnParams = fnAdaptor->attr.getParams().getValue();

  ArrayRef<mlir::Attribute> structParams;
  if (adaptor.structParams)
    structParams = adaptor.structParams.getValue();

  // Defaults are declared on the execute signature (`execute_device`'s, for a
  // declarative kernel), except that `execute_configuration` declares its own.
  KernelDeclFunctionAdaptor *defaultsFn =
      funcLabel == kMoggExecuteConfigurationFunctionLabel
          ? fnAdaptor
          : (adaptor.executeFunction ? &*adaptor.executeFunction : nullptr);
  mlir::DictionaryAttr defaultParams = computeDefaultParamsDict(defaultsFn);
  return inferParameters(fnParams, structParams, fnAdaptor->attr.getArgParams(),
                         defaultParams, fnAdaptor->attr.getSignature(),
                         inferCallback);
}

ErrorOr<InferredParameters> inferKernelParameters(
    PrimitiveDeclOp primDecl,
    std::function<ErrorOr<MojoValue>(StringRef)> &&inferCallback) {
  MOGG::KernelFunctionAttr fn = primDecl.getFunction();
  return inferParameters(fn.getParams().getValue(),
                         /*structLevelParams=*/{}, fn.getArgParams(),
                         /*defaultAttrs=*/nullptr, fn.getSignature(),
                         inferCallback);
}

ErrorOr<InferredParameters> inferKernelParameters(
    ShapeFunctionDeclOp shapeDecl,
    std::function<ErrorOr<MojoValue>(StringRef)> &&inferCallback) {
  MOGG::KernelFunctionAttr fn = shapeDecl.getFunction();
  return inferParameters(fn.getParams().getValue(),
                         /*structLevelParams=*/{}, fn.getArgParams(),
                         /*defaultAttrs=*/nullptr, fn.getSignature(),
                         inferCallback);
}

using namespace M;

void M::MO::loadDialects(mlir::DialectRegistry &registry) {
  registry.insert<MO::MODialect, MOSH::MOSHDialect, MOGG::MOGGDialect,
                  MGP::MGPDialect, GRT::GRTDialect, RMO::RMODialect,
                  MAP::MAPDialect>();
  M::registerAllKGENDialects(registry);
  M::registerKGENToLLVMTranslation(registry);
}

void M::MO::registerShapeInferencePipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<>(
      "mo-shape-inference", "Run the end-to-end shape inference pipeline.",
      buildShapeInferencePipeline);
}

void M::MO::buildJitPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm) {
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLowerCompiledRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createInlineMGPCallsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createFixupOverhangsPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createOutlineModelsToCallables());
}

namespace {
static void gcPipelineImpl(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts, bool skipJit,
                           bool dumpIntermediates = false);
} // namespace

void M::MO::registerGCPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<GCPipelineOptions>(
      "gc-pipeline", "Full graph-compiler pipeline (MO → MGP → JIT).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
        // Enable dumps here so buildGCPipeline stays dump-free for cache keys.
        gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/false,
                       /*dumpIntermediates=*/!getMaxIRDumpDir().empty());
      });
}

void M::MO::registerGCPipelineThroughEmitMojo() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<GCPipelineOptions>(
      "gc-pipeline-pre-jit",
      "Graph compiler through emit-mojo (MO → MGP → emit-mojo; no JIT).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
        gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/true,
                       /*dumpIntermediates=*/!getMaxIRDumpDir().empty());
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMoPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MoPipelineOptions>(
      "mo-pipeline",
      "Passes from graph input up to (but not including) mo-to-mogg.",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MoPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMoPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMapPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MapPipelineOptions>(
      "map-pipeline",
      "Passes between mo-to-map and mogg-to-mgp (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MapPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMapPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMoggPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MoggPipelineOptions>(
      "mogg-pipeline",
      "Passes between mo-to-mogg and mogg-to-mgp (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MoggPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMoggPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMgpPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MgpPipelineOptions>(
      "mgp-pipeline", "Passes between mogg-to-mgp and jit (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MgpPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMgpPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerJitPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<>(
      "jit-pipeline", "Passes that run after the jit pass.",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm) { buildJitPipeline(pm); });
}

void M::MO::registerPasses() {
  MO::registerShapeInferencePipeline();
  MO::registerGCPipeline();
  MO::registerGCPipelineThroughEmitMojo();
  MO::registerMoPipeline();
  MO::registerMapPipeline();
  MO::registerMoggPipeline();
  MO::registerMgpPipeline();
  MO::registerJitPipeline();
  MO::registerMOToMAPPasses();

  MAP::registerMAPTransformsPasses();
  MAP::registerMAPToMOGGPasses();

  MOGG::registerCanonicalizeFuncsForMerge();
  MOGG::registerMergeIdenticalFuncs();
  MOGG::registerAddProfileScopeTracingPass();
  MOGG::registerWrapFuncsWithTracePass();
  MOGG::registerAddTryExceptBlocksPass();
  MOGG::registerLookupConstantResources();
  MGP::registerRaiseBackIndexConstant();
  MOGG::registerOutlineAsyncRoutinesPass();
  MOGG::registerEmitMojo();
  MOGG::registerDumpMojo();
  MOGG::registerLoadMojo();
  MOGG::registerLowerCompiledRoutines();
  MGP::registerLowerPrimitives();
  MOGG::registerSequenceFusion();

  MGP::registerMGPTransformsPasses();
  MOGG::registerPasses();

  RMO::registerLegalizeRMOOpsPass();

  mlir::registerCSEPass();
  mlir::registerCanonicalizerPass();
  mlir::registerReconcileUnrealizedCastsPassPass();
  mlir::registerSCCPPass();
  mlir::registerSymbolDCEPass();
  mlir::registerViewOpGraphPass();

  KGEN::registerVerifyParametersPass();
}

LogicalResult MO::runGcPipeline(ModuleOp module,
                                const GCPipelineOptions &gcPipelineOptions) {

  mlir::PassManager pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      module.getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);

  if (!gcPipelineOptions.mlirTimingOutDir.empty()) {
    const char *pipelineName = "GC Pipeline";
    auto enabledTiming = M::configureMLIRPassTimingJSONOutput(
        pm, gcPipelineOptions.mlirTimingOutDir.getValue(), pipelineName);
    if (enabledTiming.isError()) {
      llvm::errs() << enabledTiming.getError() << "\n";
      return failure();
    }
  }

  MO::buildGCPipeline(pm, gcPipelineOptions);
  return pm.run(module);
}

void M::MO::buildMoPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                            const MoPipelineOptions &opts) {
  auto kernelLibraryPaths =
      llvm::to_vector_of<std::string>(opts.kernelLibraryPaths);

  // Skipped when the caller already seeded decls and
  // `mogg.opaque_type_mapping` via `MOGG::copyKernelDecls`. RewriteOpaqueTypes
  // still runs so freshly-cloned `!mo.opaque<"simple">` uses get rewritten.
  if (!opts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated) {
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createImportPackages(
        {.mojoPkgPaths = kernelLibraryPaths, .litMlirPaths = {}}));
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createVerifyKernels());
  }

  pm.addPass(MOGG::createRewriteOpaqueTypes());
  pm.addPass(KGEN::createVerifyParameters());

  if (opts.debugPrintAllTensors)
    pm.addPass(MO::createDebugPrintAllTensorsPass());

  pm.addPass(RMO::createLegalizeRMOOps());

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MO::createCanonicalizeChainSequences());

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  std::string_view compiledFrameworkLabel;
  if (opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.hasValue())
    compiledFrameworkLabel = opts.compiledFrameworkLabel;

  std::optional<std::string> cacheDir;
  if (opts.cacheDir.hasValue())
    cacheDir = opts.cacheDir;

  if (opts.useShapeInference)
    buildShapeInferencePipeline(pm);

  // TODO(GEX-886): Remove symbolic optimization's dependency on constant
  // folding.
  if (opts.constantFold)
    pm.addPass(MO::createConstantFoldPass(compiledFrameworkLabel, cacheDir,
                                          kernelLibraryPaths));

  pm.addPass(MO::createHoistConstantSubgraphsIntoParent());
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  SymbolicOptimizationOptions symbolicOptimizationOpts;
  symbolicOptimizationOpts.symbolicFfastMath = opts.symbolicFfastMath;
  symbolicOptimizationOpts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath =
      opts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath;

  pm.addPass(MO::createSymbolicOptimization(symbolicOptimizationOpts));
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  pm.addPass(MO::createMergeDuplicateShapeMaterializations());
  pm.addPass(MO::createAddFallbackShapeFunctions());
  pm.addPass(MO::createSymbolicOptimization(symbolicOptimizationOpts));
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  if (opts.constantFold)
    pm.addPass(MO::createConstantFoldPass(compiledFrameworkLabel, cacheDir,
                                          kernelLibraryPaths));

  pm.addPass(MO::createInferLayouts());
  if (opts.usePatterns) {
    MOGG::PatternFusionOptions patternFusionOpts;
    patternFusionOpts.mhaAllowUnsafeBCast =
        opts.patternFusionMHAAllowUnsafeBCasts;
    patternFusionOpts.mhaAllowInternalReshape =
        opts.patternFusionMHAAllowInternalReshape;
    patternFusionOpts.enableMHAPattern = opts.patternFusionMHAEnable;
    patternFusionOpts.targetDevice = opts.defaultDeviceLabel;
    patternFusionOpts.targetDeviceId = opts.defaultDeviceId;
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createPatternFusion(patternFusionOpts));

    InvokeShapePackingFunctionsOptions shapeFuncOptions;
    shapeFuncOptions.sanityCheckShapeFuncs = opts.sanityCheckShapeFuncs;

    pm.addPass(MO::createInvokeShapePackingFunctions(shapeFuncOptions));
    pm.addPass(MO::createPropagateShapes());
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  }

  MO::ValidateDevicesPassOptions validateDevicesPassOpt;
  validateDevicesPassOpt.defaultDeviceTargetTriple =
      opts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple;
  validateDevicesPassOpt.defaultDeviceTargetArch = opts.defaultDeviceTargetArch;
  pm.addPass(MO::createValidateDevicesPass(validateDevicesPassOpt));

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  // Absorb per-device consumers of an mo.tensor.unbundle back into the
  // producing mo.parallel (canonicalize collapses bundle(unbundle(X)) to X) so
  // epilogue fusion sees a single kernel body.
  pm.addPass(MO::createCreateParallelFromUnbundle());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MO::createMergeAdjacentParallels());

  if (opts.constantFold)
    pm.addPass(MO::createConstantFoldPass(compiledFrameworkLabel, cacheDir,
                                          kernelLibraryPaths));

  if (opts.fuseJitKernels) {
    // Without fusion this can add extraneous copies.
    pm.addPass(MO::createElideRedundantMutableOps());
  }

  pm.addPass(MO::createHoistParameterExpressions());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MO::createRemoveUnusedOps());
}

void M::MO::buildMapPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                             const MapPipelineOptions &opts) {
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createFuseKernels());
  if (opts.fuseMutableLoadStore)
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createFuseMutableLoads());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  // After fusion settles, give every fused-output epilogue a real store pointer
  // (plus a pre-cast accumulation buffer for mixed-precision accumulation).
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createAllocateAccumulatingBuffers());

  // An unfused reshape has no MAPToMOGG lowering (its hoisted stride op isn't
  // LowerableToMOGGInterface yet), and an unfused contiguous slice can take the
  // zero-copy path. Raise both back before outlining commits to MAP.
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createRaiseBackContiguousViews());

  pm.addPass(MAP::createOutlineStructuredKernelBodies());
  // Uniques `map.iter.opaque` inputs and captures so the lowered kernel's
  // parameter list is minimal.
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createLoopInvariantViewMotion());
  // CSE before canonicalize: two loads hoisting the same view create identical
  // stride ops; CSE must unify them so DedupeCapturingClosureCaptures can fold
  // the duplicate captures.
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
}

void M::MO::buildMoggPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                              const MoggPipelineOptions &) {
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLegalizeRowwiseKernels());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createConformCallOperands());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createOutlineRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createWrapFuncsWithTrace());

  // On the module, not GraphOp: the outlined stubs are its siblings.
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
}

void M::MO::buildMgpPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                             const MgpPipelineOptions &opts) {
  auto kernelLibraryPaths =
      llvm::to_vector_of<std::string>(opts.kernelLibraryPaths);

  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createConcatInPlacePass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createExecInvariantCodeMotionPass());

  // After ExecInvariantCodeMotion: buffer reuse can block hoisting.
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimpleBufferReusePass());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createDynamicMemoryPlanningPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createDeferAllocsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createVerifyModelArgumentsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createPredicateAssertDependenciesPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  // Before any fusion.
  pm.addPass(MGP::createAttachPythonStackTraces());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createGlobalizeSlotIndicesPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  MGP::LowerPrimitivesOptions lowerPrimOpts;
  lowerPrimOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  lowerPrimOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
  pm.addPass(MGP::createLowerPrimitives(lowerPrimOpts));

  {
    pm.addPass(MGP::createStageDeviceGraphsPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createPartitionDeviceGraphCollectivePass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createComputeDeviceGraphDependenciesPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyDeviceGraphDependenciesPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createGenerateBuildGraphStubsPass());
    // Drop the dead launch context chain before finalization audits the
    // builder bridge's live users.
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createFinalizeDeviceGraphsPass());
    pm.addPass(mlir::createReconcileUnrealizedCastsPass());
  }

  pm.addPass(MOGG::createSequenceFusion());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyExtendLifetimesPass());

  pm.addPass(MOGG::createOutlineAsyncRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLookupConstantResources());

  // Lifting slot-index constants into stub arguments lets kernels differing
  // only in those indices merge below.
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLiftBufferCacheSlots());

  // The emitted Mojo reads neither device ids nor symbolic dim names, so
  // erasing them lets per-device and per-layer copies merge below.
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createCanonicalizeFuncsForMerge());

  // Stubs that differ only by a redundant op merge once it is gone.
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createMergeIdenticalFuncs());

  // index.constant emits fewer lines of Mojo than its lowered form.
  pm.addPass(MGP::createRaiseBackIndexConstant());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createFixupOverhangsPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MOGG::FuncOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());

  // Drop stubs orphaned by MergeIdenticalFuncs.
  pm.addPass(mlir::createSymbolDCEPass());

  // Before try/except wrapping: the begin/end Trace calls raise, and the
  // MGP-ABI entry point must not.
  if (opts.enableProfileScopeTracing) {
    MOGG::AddProfileScopeTracingOptions profileScopeOptions;
    profileScopeOptions.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled =
        opts.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled;
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createAddProfileScopeTracing(profileScopeOptions));
  }

  // Last, so it sees the final raising set; try/except around non-raising
  // code warns in the Mojo compiler.
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createAddTryExceptBlocks());

  MOGG::EmitMojoOptions emitMojoOptions;
  emitMojoOptions.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  emitMojoOptions.enableOpTraceComments = opts.enableOpTraceComments;
  emitMojoOptions.enableComputeLambdas = opts.enableComputeLambdas;
  emitMojoOptions.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs =
      opts.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs;
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createEmitMojo(emitMojoOptions));

  if (opts.dumpMojoText)
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createDumpMojo());
}

namespace {

/// Appends every gc-pipeline stage to `pm`. With `dumpIntermediates`, a
/// DumpStagePass runs before the first stage and after each one.
static void gcPipelineImpl(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts, bool skipJit,
                           bool dumpIntermediates) {

  auto kernelLibraryPaths =
      llvm::to_vector_of<std::string>(opts.kernelLibraryPaths);

  // Filled by the first ("mo") dump from the non-subgraph model names while
  // the GraphOps still exist; later dumps reuse it.
  auto dumpBaseName = std::make_shared<std::string>();

  if (dumpIntermediates)
    pm.addPass(MO::createDumpStagePass("mo", dumpBaseName));

  MoPipelineOptions moOpts;
  moOpts.debugPrintAllTensors = opts.debugPrintAllTensors;
  moOpts.useShapeInference = opts.useShapeInference;
  moOpts.constantFold = opts.constantFold;
  if (opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.hasValue())
    moOpts.compiledFrameworkLabel = opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.getValue();
  if (opts.cacheDir.hasValue())
    moOpts.cacheDir = opts.cacheDir.getValue();
  moOpts.symbolicFfastMath = opts.symbolicFfastMath;
  moOpts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath = opts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath;
  moOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  moOpts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated = opts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated;
  moOpts.usePatterns = opts.usePatterns;
  moOpts.patternFusionMHAEnable = opts.patternFusionMHAEnable;
  moOpts.patternFusionMHAAllowUnsafeBCasts =
      opts.patternFusionMHAAllowUnsafeBCasts;
  moOpts.patternFusionMHAAllowInternalReshape =
      opts.patternFusionMHAAllowInternalReshape;
  moOpts.sanityCheckShapeFuncs = opts.sanityCheckShapeFuncs;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceLabel = opts.defaultDeviceLabel;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceId = opts.defaultDeviceId;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple = opts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceTargetArch = opts.defaultDeviceTargetArch;
  moOpts.fuseJitKernels = opts.fuseJitKernels;

  MapPipelineOptions mapOpts;
  mapOpts.fuseMutableLoadStore = opts.fuseMutableLoadStore;

  MoggPipelineOptions moggOpts;

  MGP::MOGGToMGPOptions moToPrimOpts;
  moToPrimOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
  if (opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.hasValue())
    moToPrimOpts.compiledFrameworkLabel = opts.compiledFrameworkLabel;

  MgpPipelineOptions mgpOpts;
  mgpOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  mgpOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
  mgpOpts.enableOpTraceComments = opts.enableOpTraceComments;
  mgpOpts.enableComputeLambdas = opts.enableComputeLambdas;
  mgpOpts.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs = opts.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs;
  mgpOpts.dumpMojoText = opts.dumpMojoText;
  mgpOpts.enableProfileScopeTracing = opts.enableProfileScopeTracing;
  mgpOpts.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled =
      opts.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled;

  MOGG::JitCompileKernelsOptions jitOpts;
  if (!skipJit) {
    jitOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
    jitOpts.saveTempPrefix = opts.saveTempPrefix;
    jitOpts.createMOGGReproducers = opts.createMOGGReproducers;
    jitOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
    jitOpts.timeMOGGCompile = opts.timeMOGGCompile;
    jitOpts.debugKGENStubs = opts.debugKGENStubs;
    // Cross-compile for the requested GPU instead of probing the host.
    jitOpts.defaultDeviceTargetArch = opts.defaultDeviceTargetArch;
    jitOpts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple = opts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple;
    jitOpts.compileForHostExecution = opts.compileForHostExecution;
  }

  auto buildStage = [&](auto &&build, const std::string &dumpSuffix) {
    build(pm);
    if (dumpIntermediates && !dumpSuffix.empty())
      pm.addPass(MO::createDumpStagePass(dumpSuffix, dumpBaseName));
  };

  buildStage([&](auto &p) { buildMoPipeline(p, moOpts); }, "mo-pre-map");

  // Stable-tensor marking must see MO ops, so it runs as the last MO-level
  // pass before the dialect is lowered away.
  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        p.addPass(MO::createMarkStableTensorsPass());
        p.addPass(MO::createMOToMAP());
      },
      "mo-to-map");

  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        buildMapPipeline(p, mapOpts);
        // After MAP fusion so a check never fuses into the kernel it checks;
        // before map-to-mogg so the injected checks compile with the rest.
        if (opts.nanCheck)
          p.addPass(MO::createNanCheckPass(opts.nanCheckStride));
      },
      "map-pre-mogg");

  MAP::MAPToMOGGOptions mapToMoggOpts;
  mapToMoggOpts.enableComputeLambdas = opts.enableComputeLambdas;
  buildStage([&](auto &p) { p.addPass(MAP::createMAPToMOGG(mapToMoggOpts)); },
             "map-to-mogg");

  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        buildMoggPipeline(p, moggOpts);
        // OpaqueLoc tracebacks can't be printed, so convert them for the
        // dump. Dump-only: this strips the OpaqueLocs buildMgpPipeline's
        // assert handling reads.
        if (dumpIntermediates)
          p.addPass(MGP::createAttachPythonStackTraces());
      },
      "mogg-pre-mgp");

  buildStage([&](auto &p) { p.addPass(MGP::createMOGGToMGP(moToPrimOpts)); },
             "mogg-to-mgp");

  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        buildMgpPipeline(p, mgpOpts);
        if (!skipJit) {
          p.addPass(MOGG::createJitCompileKernels(jitOpts));
          p.addPass(MOGG::createStripKernelDecls());
          buildJitPipeline(p);
        }
      },
      "mgp");
}

} // namespace

void M::MO::buildGCPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                            const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
  gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/false);
}

void M::MO::buildGCPipelineThroughEmitMojo(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
  gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/true);
}

LogicalResult M::MO::runGCPipeline(ModuleOp moduleOp,
                                   const GCPipelineOptions &opts,
                                   bool dumpIntermediates) {
  auto pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      moduleOp.getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);

  if (!opts.mlirTimingOutDir.empty()) {
    auto enabledTiming = M::configureMLIRPassTimingJSONOutput(
        pm, opts.mlirTimingOutDir.getValue(), "GC Pipeline");
    if (enabledTiming.isError()) {
      llvm::errs() << enabledTiming.getError() << "\n";
      return failure();
    }
  }

  gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/opts.preJit, dumpIntermediates);
  return pm.run(moduleOp);
}

void M::MO::buildShapeInferencePipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm) {
  // Turns static reshapes like `[D0] -> [1]` into rebinds (so staticization
  // needn't look through them) and materializes parameter definitions for
  // `mo.rebind`s that still declare output parameters.
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());

  // Evaluates constant ops and shape functions in the parameter domain, then
  // simplifies parameter bindings by substitution and constraint solving.
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(MO::createPropagateShapes());
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(KGEN::createVerifyParameters());
}

using BlobMap = DenseMap<const uint8_t *, mlir::AsmResourceBlob *>;

static BlobMap getDenseResources(ModuleOp module) {
  BlobMap result;
  for (Operation &op : module.getOps()) {
    if (auto modelOp = dyn_cast<MGP::ModelOp>(op)) {
      modelOp.walk([&](MGP::BufferConstantOp constOp) {
        auto elementsAttr = constOp.getValue();
        if (auto resourceAttr =
                dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(elementsAttr)) {
          mlir::AsmResourceBlob *blob = resourceAttr.getRawHandle().getBlob();
          if (blob->getDeleter())
            result[blob->getDataAs<uint8_t>().data()] = blob;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  return result;
}

ErrorOr<BufferRef> M::MO::convertMGPToMEF(ModuleOp module,
                                          bool enableMEFMetadata) {
  OwningOpRef<ModuleOp> moduleToRewrite = module.clone();
  // Device-generic ops get renamed with their device label so GraphRT can
  // dispatch to a device-appropriate primitive.
  BlobMap resources = getDenseResources(*moduleToRewrite);
  mlir::PassManager pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      module->getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);
  pm.addPass(MGP::createPrepareDevicePrimitivesPass());
  FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler diagnostics(moduleToRewrite->getContext());
  if (failed(pm.run(*moduleToRewrite)))
    return Error(Twine("Failed to prepare MGP model for conversion to MEF. ") +
                 diagnostics.formatMessage());
  ConcatenationTree result =
      translateMLIRToMEF(*moduleToRewrite, enableMEFMetadata);
  if (result.getSize() == 0) {
    return Error(Twine("Failed to convert model to MEF. ") +
                 diagnostics.formatMessage());
  }
  M::WriteableBufferRef outputBuffer = WriteableBuffer::get(
      0, maxAttributeAlignment().value(), result.getSize());
  result.traverse([&](ArrayRef<uint8_t> data) {
    outputBuffer->write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(data.data()),
                        data.size());
    if (resources.count(data.data())) {
      if (auto blob = resources[data.data()]; blob->getDeleter()) {
        // Free owned blob data as soon as it's been copied out.
        auto ref = M::GML::BlobLifetimeManager(std::move(blob->getDeleter()),
                                               blob->getData(),
                                               blob->getDataAlignment());
        blob->getDeleter() = nullptr;
      }
    }
  });

  return outputBuffer;
}

void EmitMojoState::setFusionStructLoweringFor(Value val, MojoValue instance,
                                               StringLiteral bindMethod,
                                               MojoValue typeName) {
  [[maybe_unused]] auto [it, inserted] = lambdaLowerings.try_emplace(
      val,
      FusionStructInfo{std::move(instance), bindMethod, std::move(typeName)});
  ASSERT_STREAM(inserted, << "value already bound to a lambda lowering");
}

void EmitMojoState::emitOutputStoreFusionDefsOnce() {
  if (emittedOutputStoreFusionArgDefs)
    return;
  structDefsBuilder.verbatim(MojoValue(kOutputStoreFusionDefs.str()));
  emittedOutputStoreFusionArgDefs = true;
}

#define EMITS_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(OpTy)                                            \
  LogicalResult emitMojo(OpTy op, EmitMojoState &state);
#define EMIT_MOJO_EXTERNALLY(OpTy)                                             \
  if (auto asOp = dyn_cast<OpTy>(op)) {                                        \
    if (emitMojo(asOp, state).failed()) {                                      \
      return op->emitError()                                                   \
             << "'" << op->getName() << "' could not be lowered to Mojo";      \
    }                                                                          \
    return success();                                                          \
  }
